jobs.title: Product Manager confirmé H/F - SaaS - Fintech
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers. Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, notre solution N2F s’impose comme une référence sur le marché français.

N2F est une plateforme complète de Spend Management (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs, budget), conçue pour simplifier le quotidien des entreprises grâce à une expérience fluide, intuitive et 100 % connectée (web et mobile).

Portés par une équipe engagée, qui place l’humain au centre de ses priorités, nous poursuivons une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Pour accompagner cette croissance, nous recherchons un(e) Product Manager confirmé(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe Produit et prendre la responsabilité d’un domaine fonctionnel clé de notre plateforme. Le terrain de jeu est vaste et les défis nombreux : internationalisation, intelligence artificielle, agents, automatisation des workflows, interconnectivité, refonte fonctionnelle et amélioration continue de l’expérience utilisateur.

Tes principales missions :

Rattaché(e) à la VP Product, tu seras responsable d’un domaine fonctionnel de notre plateforme et de son évolution à long terme.

Stratégie de Produit :

  • Définir et porter la vision de ton domaine produit.

  • Comprendre en profondeur les besoins des clients, des utilisateurs et des équipes internes.

  • Analyser les tendances du marché, la concurrence et les évolutions technologiques afin d’identifier les meilleures opportunités de développement.

  • Participer à l’identification et à l’évaluation de nouveaux cas d’usage liés à l’IA, à l’automatisation et aux agents.

Gestion du Cycle de Vie du Produit :

  • Construire et piloter la roadmap de ton périmètre.

  • Identifier, qualifier et prioriser les opportunités en fonction de leur impact utilisateur et business.

  • Superviser le cycle de vie complet des fonctionnalités, de la discovery au lancement avec le Product marketing.

  • Mesurer les résultats et ajuster les orientations en fonction des retours terrain et des données.

Développement de Produit :

  • Piloter la conception et le développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités avec les équipes Product Design et Engineering.

  • Garantir une expérience utilisateur simple, intuitive et performante.

  • Valider les solutions proposées grâce à des tests utilisateurs, des analyses de données et des expérimentations.

  • Veiller à délivrer des solutions pragmatiques, robustes et créatrices de valeur.

Le travail collaboratif est au cœur du rôle :

  • Travailler étroitement avec les équipes Sales, Customer Success et Support afin de comprendre les enjeux clients.

  • Communiquer régulièrement avec les parties prenantes internes et externes.

  • Favoriser l’alignement autour des priorités produit.

  • Participer à la promotion du produit en interne et en externe.

  • Contribuer à la diffusion de la culture Produit au sein de l’entreprise.


Ce que l’on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu disposes d’au moins 4 ans d’expérience en tant que Product Manager, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS B2B.

  • Tu sais appréhender des problématiques métier complexes et les transformer en solutions simples et efficaces.

  • Tu maîtrises les méthodologies agiles et les bonnes pratiques Produit.

  • Tu es capable de piloter un sujet en autonomie et d’embarquer les équipes autour de tes projets.

  • Tu sais arbitrer, prioriser et faire des choix pragmatiques et orientés impact.

  • Tu as déjà mené des projets d’envergure impliquant plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Tu possèdes d’excellentes compétences en communication et en collaboration.

  • Tu es curieux(se), rigoureux(se) et tu cherches à comprendre les sujets en profondeur avant de prendre des décisions.

  • Tu disposes d’un esprit analytique fort tout en gardant une forte orientation utilisateur.

  • Une sensibilité forte à l’IA est attendue

    • Tu t’intéresses activement aux évolutions de l’intelligence artificielle et à leurs applications concrètes dans les produits SaaS.

    • Tu utilises régulièrement des outils tels que ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini ou des assistants IA similaires dans ton quotidien professionnel.

    • Tu sais identifier les opportunités où l’IA, les LLM, l’OCR ou les agents peuvent apporter une valeur tangible aux utilisateurs.

    • Tu sais distinguer les effets de mode des usages réellement créateurs de valeur.

  • Tu es bilingue Français / anglais.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Rejoindre une entreprise rentable, en forte croissance et ambitieuse à l’échelle européenne.

  • Travailler sur un produit utilisé par plus d’un million d’utilisateurs à travers le monde.

  • Évoluer dans une équipe Produit structurée composée de Product Managers, Product Designers et Product Marketing Manager.

  • Contribuer à des sujets stratégiques mêlant SaaS, finance, IA et automatisation.

  • Bénéficier d’un environnement collaboratif où les idées sont écoutées et où l’impact individuel est réel.

  • Avoir la possibilité de délivrer rapidement de la valeur et de voir concrètement les résultats de son travail.

Poste ouvert en CDI et full remote.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Project Manager - PMO (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Technical Project Manager (all genders) to join our PMO team as soon as possible. We embrace a remote-first approach (within Germany), but you can choose whether you’d like to work in a hybrid model or entirely on-site, depending on your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Hamburg, Cologne, Munich).


As a Senior Technical Project Manager, you are a cornerstone of strategy execution at Contabo – and you're joining at a time when a lot is moving strategically. Alongside the continued evolution of our existing cloud infrastructure, we are driving initiatives that will expand our portfolio well beyond what exists today over the coming years. This is exactly where your role comes in: embedded in our PMO, you take end-to-end ownership of technical projects across development teams and business functions – including initiatives for which no blueprint exists yet, where you help shape structures from the ground up.

You work at the intersection of technology and business: you translate sometimes still ambiguous requirements into executable plans, actively challenge requirements, and structure initiatives into scalable roadmaps, iterations, and implementation phases. In your day-to-day work, you coordinate priorities, dependencies, and delivery sequencing across multiple teams and parallel workstreams, identify resource bottlenecks and delivery risks early, and ensure transparency through structured reporting, clear governance, and effective escalation management – especially when scope and priorities shift in our fast-moving environment. You'll be working with tools like Jira, Confluence, and comparable solutions.

Beyond individual projects, you shape the PMO itself: you continuously develop our standards and processes, support portfolio alignment and prioritisation, and share your knowledge as a mentor to junior project managers. A lean PMO at Contabo means a high degree of autonomy and genuine ownership – you report directly to the Head of Strategy Execution & ESG and contribute measurably to the execution of Contabo's strategic roadmap.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:

  • 5+ years of experience in technical project or program management within software development or technical delivery organisations
  • Proven end-to-end delivery ownership of cross-functional initiatives with multiple parallel workstreams – not limited to governance or status-reporting roles
  • Strong experience in stakeholder and escalation management
  • A high degree of ownership and composure in an environment of shifting priorities and ambiguity
  • Confident use of common PM tooling such as Jira, Confluence (or comparable)
  • Experience in a cloud, hosting, or IT infrastructure environment, as well as with agile scaling, PMO, or portfolio management (a plus)
  • A completed degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Engineering, or a comparable qualification
  • Professional fluency in English; German language skills and certifications (PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe, PSM) are a plus

We know that you may not currently meet all of these requirements. But if you bring the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm for the role, we can achieve great things together.


Awesome Prospects

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.

What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office
  • Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
  • Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities
  • Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program
  • Recharge your energy – 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve
  • Give back – An extra day off to get involved in social activities through our Volunteer Day
  • Make an impact – Take ownership and bring your ideas to life with real creative freedom
  • Keep growing – Individual professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative tech environment
  • Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations
  • Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity
  • Create lasting memories – Company events and team activities you won’t forget


How to reach us

If you have any questions, you can reach out to Max by email at .

jobs.title: Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • Programmatic AdTech Domain Expertise: 3–4 years of Product Management experience (with at least 3 years directly in Programmatic, Ad Exchange, SSP, or DSP environments) to lead our DSP-facing ad exchange capabilities across their full lifecycle. You thrive when dissecting OpenRTB specs, auction mechanics, and mobile formats (video, playable, native, display) to turn programmatic complexities into clear product roadmaps.

  • Technical Infrastructure & API Fluency: Hands-on comfort working alongside senior engineers to parse system architecture, API designs, JSON data payloads, and latency tracking. You will bridge technical execution with business strategy across a platform running 20+ Go microservices on Kubernetes and Kafka, orchestrating 1,500 bid requests per second.

  • Auction Mechanics & Traffic Shaping: Deep analytical capability to optimize win rates, timeout rates, bid density, and Supply Path Optimization (SPO). You will design smart throttling and routing logic that reduces infrastructure QPS costs while maximizing revenue across 120M processed auctions daily.

  • Cross-Functional Partner Integration: Direct technical collaboration with the Demand Partnerships team and external partners to lead DSP onboardings and maintain OpenRTB compliance. You act as the translation layer between client feedback, external demand needs, and detailed Product Requirements Documents (PRDs).

  • Data-Driven Metric Ownership: Relentless focus on defining and monitoring core performance indicators including fill rate, bid rate, CPM, and eCPM. You will partner with data teams to analyze complex data sets, troubleshoot technical issues, and measure feature performance alongside ML models making 50 billion daily predictions.

  • Agile Product Delivery: Proven track record of owning end-to-end execution, experimentation, and scaling in an Agile environment. You manage multi-stakeholder dependencies cleanly and ship high-throughput features iteratively without sacrificing low-latency requirements.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

jobs.title: Product Manager E-Invoicing (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Warum Wir?

Bei uns erwarten Dich weltweit verteilte, internationale Teams, flache Hierarchien und eine offene Unternehmenskultur, die zum Mitgestalten einlädt. Mobiles Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten gehören für uns zum Alltag. Möchtest Du Teil eines innovativen Unternehmens werden, dessen Lösung den Arbeitsalltag in unterschiedlichsten Branchen digitalisiert? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams!


Das erwartet Dich

Als Product Manager (m/w/d) verantwortest Du die Anbindung von DocuWare an Netzwerke zum Austausch von e-Invoices in Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering-, UX- und Compliance-Spezialisten. Gemeinsam stellt Ihr sicher, dass DocuWare die Anforderungen unserer Kunden an den Austausch von elektronischen Rechnungen erfüllt. Dabei behältst Du die regulatorischen Anforderungen und Zeitpläne im Blick und hilfst unseren Kunden, diese mit DocuWare zu erfüllen. 

Du kannst dich in die Lage unserer Anwenderinnen und Anwender versetzen und ihre Probleme und täglichen Aufgaben nachvollziehen? Du bist neugierig, arbeitest gerne lösungsorientiert und im Team, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und bist ein Organisationstalent? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, Dich kennen zu lernen! 
Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehören:

  • Du verfolgst die Entwicklungen und Anforderungen für e-Invoicing in und außerhalb Europa in Zusammenarbeit mit externen und internen Compliance-Spezialisten.
  • Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für die Anforderungen und Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden.
  • Du agierst dabei kundenzentriert, holst Kundenfeedback ein und analysierst Daten, um die richtigen Entscheidungen abzuleiten.
  • Du formulierst präzise Anforderung zu den Kundenproblemen und -bedürfnissen.
  • Du entwirfst die kurz-, mittel- und langfristige Strategie und Roadmap für Deinen Bereich unseres Produkts und führst das Team mit Zielen und KPIs.
  • Du prägst eine konstruktive und integrative Zusammenarbeit innerhalb der Produktteams und agierst als Teamschnittstelle zu Stakeholdern.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Softwareentwicklern und UX-Spezialisten an der Implementierung des Produktes im Rahmen des SCRUM-Frameworks zusammen.


Das bringst Du mit

  • Du verfügst über breites und tiefes Wissen im Bereich e-Invoicing.
  • Die Begriffe XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, FatturaPA und Factur-X sind für Dich keine Unbekannten.
  • Du kannst die Unterschiede zwischen PEPPOL, SDI, Chorus Pro und FACe in wenigen Worten verständlich erklären.
  • Du hast Erfahrung als Produktmanager für Software-Produkte. Erfahrung mit B2B Software ist ein Plus.
  • Erfahrung in der Arbeit in einem agilen Umfeld (beispielsweise als SCRUM Product Owner).
  • Du hast Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Endnutzern und der Lösungsgestaltung anhand deren Bedürfnissen.
  • Du verfügst über ausgeprägte organisatorische Fähigkeiten, arbeitest zielorientiert und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung.
  • Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete verbale und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um komplexe Sachverhalte verständlich darzulegen.
  • Eine Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Teamfähigkeit zeichnen Dich aus.
  • Fließende Englischkenntnisse, Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus.


Darauf kannst Du Dich freuen

Es gibt viele gute Gründe für DocuWare – unsere Unternehmenskultur ist nur einer davon.
 Im Team von DocuWare profitierst auch Du von diesen Vorteilen:

  • Weltweit verteilte, internationale Teams: Du triffst uns in Germering, New York, Sofia oder vielen anderen Locations.
  • Flexibler Arbeitsort und Arbeitszeit: Du arbeitest mobil oder in unserem modernen und gut ausgestattetem Büro – dabei teilst Du Dir deine Arbeitszeit flexibel ein.
  • Individuelle Förderung: Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitung bekommst Du regelmäßig auf Dich zugeschnittene Weiterbildungen (u.a. Kongresse, interne Teambuilding Maßnahmen).
  • Wohl verdiente Erholung: Neben 35 Urlaubstagen im Jahr bieten wir Dir ein breites Sport- und Massageangebot, Kicker-Tisch und einen entspannenden Lounge-Bereich.
  • Gesunde Ernährung: Zusammen genießen wir Fairtrade Kaffee mit Bio-Milch oder HaferDrink, Snacks und frisches Obst – alles kostenlos – sowie bezuschussten Lunch aus dem Foodji-Kühlschrank. 
  • Team-Spirit: Regelmäßige Events für Mitarbeitende - virtuell oder vor Ort sorgen für Zusammenhalt.
  • Nachhaltigkeit und soziales Engagement: DocuWare steht für papierloses Arbeiten und unterstützt ehrenamtliche Organisationen und lokale Sportvereine.
  • Gute Erreichbarkeit auf allen Wegen: Komm ins Büro mit dem geleasten E-Bike (Jobrad), per S-Bahn oder über die Autobahnen A96/A99 (Dein E-Auto kannst Du vor Ort kostenlos laden).
  • Du sorgst vor & wir unterstützen Dich dabei: DocuWare bezuschusst Deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
  • Ein stabiler Arbeitsplatz: In unserem langjährig bestehenden und stetig wachsenden Unternehmen erhältst Du eine unbefristete Festanstellung.
  • Wir nutzen immer die neuesten Technologien: Erfahre mehr auf Stackshare.
  • Einzigartige Vorteile: Wähle eine von drei großartigen Optionen (Bonago, E-Gym oder Bezuschussung des Deutschlandtickets) nach Deinen Bedürfnissen.
  • 30 Tage Work from Abroad: Erlebe internationale Erfahrungen und erweitere Deinen Horizont.
  • Family First: Bevorzugte Anmeldung in unserer ausgewählten Kindertagesstätte in Germering (keine Garantie).
  • Buddy Programm: Du erhältst einen Buddy, der Dir den Einstieg erleichtert und Dich in Deinen ersten Wochen bei DocuWare unterstützt.
Für noch mehr Einblicke, schau doch gerne auf unserem Instagram vorbei!

jobs.title: AI Product Owner (Lyon, France)
jobs.description:
Location : Lyon, France

About ARCHIMED

With offices in Europe, North America and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare industries. Its mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise allows ARCHIMED to serve as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Prioritized areas of focus include Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Healthcare IT, In Vitro Diagnostics, Life Science Tools and Biologic Services, MedTech, and Pharma Services.

ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services. ARCHIMED manages €8 billion across its various funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based General Partner. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed Impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation.

The Team

  • An international team (with more than 38 nationalities) with complementary education and experience in investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational sectors
  • Composed of alumni from: INSEAD, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, Ponts et Chaussées, ESSEC, Imperial College, Dartmouth, etc.
  • Professional backgrounds: Private Equity, Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), MandA (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC), Industry

Requirements

Location: Lyon, France

Contract: Permanent (CDI)

As part of ARCHIMED's Information Systems Department (ISD), reporting directly to our Data/AI Manager, you will drive the development and deployment of Artificial Intelligence solutions across the firm. Acting as the bridge between technical teams, business stakeholders, and the Data/AI leadership, you will ensure that AI initiatives are delivered with strategic alignment, operational rigor, and measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities

1.       Product Development and Strategic Alignment

·       Collaborate on defining the product vision and roadmap for AI initiatives, in close alignment with firm priorities.

·       Translate & challenge business needs into clear, actionable product requirements and user stories

·       Ensure AI solutions deliver measurable value and are adopted effectively across business lines

 

2.        Backlog Management

·       Own, prioritize and continuously refine the product backlog in collaboration with business & development teams

·       Ensure delivery cadence is maintained and risks are proactively escalated

3.        Business Partnering and Change Management

·       Act as the primary point of contact for business stakeholders, gathering needs, managing expectations and driving adoption

·       Support business teams in understanding AI capabilities and in defining use cases with high ROI potential

·       Lead change management efforts to ensure smooth integration of AI tools into existing workflows

·       Manage & develop support materials

 

4.       AI Expertise and Innovation

·       Maintain an up-to-date knowledge of AI/ML trends, tools and best practices relevant to company’s needs

·       Evaluate new AI solutions and vendors, providing informed recommendations to the ISD leadership

·       Ensure responsible AI principles (explainability, fairness, data privacy …) throughout product development & usage

 

5.       Coordination and Governance

·       Coordinate cross-functional teams (Compliance, Cyber, Business) to ensure end-to-end delivery

·       Define and monitor KPIs to track product performance and adoption

·       Contribute to AI governance frameworks, documentation standards and reporting to senior stakeholders

 

 

 

Profile and Qualifications

·       Education: Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Business or a related field

·       Experience: Minimum 5 years as a Product Owner or Product Manager, with at least one significant AI or data-driven product deployment

·       Solid understanding of AI, data pipelines and modern development methodologies  & technologies

·       Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into business language and vice versa

·       Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience working across technical and non-technical teams

·       Analytical mindset with a structured, problem-solving approach

·       Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (French is a plus)

·       Experience in financial services, private equity or healthcare is a plus

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Project Manager (Relocation to Luxembourg)
jobs.description:
Please note that this opportunity requires relocation to our Luxembourg office.

About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

What you'll be doing

As our Senior Strategic Project Manager within the Office of the CEO, you will be a primary execution driver behind our most critical cross-functional initiatives. You will serve as the strategic bridge connecting executive leadership with operational, regulatory, product, and business teams across our Luxembourg and Milan hubs.

While you will work side-by-side with internal Legal, Compliance, and Risk experts who own the regulatory subject matter, your core strength is senior strategic leadership and project execution: acting as a key leader within the organization to orchestrate complex initiatives across different verticals, driving high-impact project timelines, and turning corporate obligations into seamless operational workflows.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Solve complex business challenges - Tackling intricate business problems by developing innovative, data-backed solutions with a consistent user-first approach.

  • Stakeholder management and strategic partnership - Managing relationships with C-level stakeholders and acting as a thought partner for leadership on specific strategic areas.

  • Strategic influence - Influencing major decisions through in-depth analysis and proven insights, integrating diverse perspectives into coherent strategies.

  • Champion methodology and best practices - Developing and introducing new methodologies, best practices, or frameworks within the team or company, ensuring a consistent user-first approach.

  • Champion Regulatory Requirements in Roadmap Design - Act as the project manager champion for what regulatory and supervisory requirements apply to a given initiative, ensuring they are proactively factored into project roadmaps at the design stage - partnering closely with Legal, Compliance, and Risk.

  • Govern & Monitor Multi-Hub Projects - Establish project governance, track milestones across offices, proactively remove cross-departmental bottlenecks, mitigate delivery risks, and provide crisp, data-driven reporting to executive leadership.

  • Anchor Luxembourg Operational Synergies - Serve as an authoritative on-the-ground project leader in Luxembourg, ensuring that financial institution governance requirements seamlessly harmonize with Satispay’s group-wide strategy and product velocity.

Who we're looking for

This role needs someone who is a problem-solver that loves teamwork, gets things done, and is ready for real ownership across regulated financial environments.

  • Experience - Minimum 6–7 years of hands-on experience within a regulated environment -ideally within high-growth Fintech, Scale-ups, EMI/Banking institutions, or Financial Services.

  • Regulatory Expertise - Hands-on knowledge and deep familiarity with compliance, legal, and regulatory matters.

  • Master Project Operator - Proven track record of managing complex, end-to-end multi-stakeholder initiatives using structured project management frameworks.

  • Fintech & EMI Licensing Awareness - Good high-level familiarity with the fintech landscape, EMI/payment institution dynamics, and European financial regulation concepts (PSD2/PSD3, AML/CFT, GDPR) — enough to translate requirements into project delivery without needing to be the legal specialist yourself.

  • Cross-Border Leadership - Demonstrated ability to build consensus, establish momentum, and align priorities across distributed international offices and matrixed teams.

  • Executive Presence - Exceptional communication skills with the ability to synthesize technical, operational, and regulatory concepts into clear, executive-level narratives and actionable plans.

  • Mobility - Based in Luxembourg with a willingness for frequent, hands-on collaboration travel to our Milan headquarters.

  • Languages - Fluent in English (written and spoken). Italian is a strong asset.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.

CareAbout: how we support your impact

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world.

That’s why we created CareAbout:

  • ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.

  • 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.

  • ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.

  • 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.

  • 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.

*We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.

Equal opportunity employer

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin. Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!

À propos de N2JSoft

N2JSoft est une Fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Fondée en 2015, elle compte aujourd’hui 20 000 clients et 1M utilisateurs dans 98 pays, faisant de N2F l’un des leaders du marché français.

N2F simplifie la gestion des frais professionnels : photo des justificatifs, reconnaissance automatique, validation, export comptable, archivage à valeur probante, etc.

L’objectif : faire gagner du temps aux entreprises tout en sécurisant leurs processus internes.

Après une croissance progressive, l’équipe est passée de 20 personnes en 2021 à 220 aujourd’hui, portée par le succès produit et l’expansion internationale.

Nous partageons un objectif commun : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des notes de frais et des factures fournisseurs.

En 2021, N2JSoft a élargi son expertise avec Keeple, un logiciel RH dédié aux congés, absences et temps de travail (hors périmètre de ce poste).

Nous prévoyons de recruter 100 nouveaux collaborateurs d’ici 2027. Notre objectif est également d’accélérer la croissance de nos produits, ce qui passe par le renforcement de notre équipe de développement.

Quelques chiffres

  • 220 collaborateurs, dont 45 dans l'équipe tech

  • Notre site est basé à Montagnat (01) avec un format de télétravail hybride ou full remote.

L’équipe tech

Notre équipe est composée de développeurs/euses full stack expérimenté(e)s, réparti(e)s en squads : Notes de frais, Cartes de paiement pro, Invoices, Core…

Chaque squad réunit : développeurs/euses, tech lead, team lead, product manager et testeur/euses QA.

Stack et pratiques

Front : Angular 16/21

Back : .NET 10 – C#

Infra : AWS

BDD : MSSQL, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB

Architecture : monolithe modulaire

Bonnes pratiques : tests unitaires, revues de code, pair programming, couverture Qodana, Microsoft Release Flow.

Méthodo : Agile Scrum, sprints de 2 semaines (daily, weekly, rétro, planning).


Le profil recherché

Rattaché(e) à un(e) Team Lead dans l'une des squads produit, tu disposes :

  • D'une formation en informatique Bac+3 minimum

  • De 3 ans d’expérience en .NET / C# (web ou backend)

  • De 2 ans d'expérience sur Angular et de bonnes connaissances front-end (HTML/CSS, TypeScript)

  • D'une bonne maîtrise de SQL

  • D'une expérience avec les technologies Cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP) et Docker

Et tu fais preuve :

  • D'esprit d’équipe pour travailler dans un climat de confiance, d'entraide et de responsabilité partagée

  • De curiosité et d'ouverture pour comprendre le besoin de nos utilisateurs et l'environnement technique

  • De pragmatisme et rigueur pour produire un code fiable avec un impact maîtrisé.

Les points d’attention :

  • Il est crucial de bien comprendre le périmètre fonctionnel du produit pour réussir dans ce poste.

  • Nous recherchons quelqu’un qui souhaite s’investir dans la durée et contribuer à la construction d’un projet pérenne, plutôt qu’à une mission ponctuelle.

Les plus :

  • Une croissance forte et continue (50% par an depuis 3 ans) dans une entreprise rentable

  • Une structure claire et spécialisée avec une équipe tech solide et des squads bien identifiées

  • Une stack moderne régulièrement mise à jour, avec des migrations planifiées et suivies

  • Pas de micro management et une culture de travail basée sur la confiance et l’écoute

  • La possibilité de faire du full-remote avec une semaine de présence par trimestre

Processus de recrutement

  1. Préqualification avec nos recruteurs

  2. Test technique à réaliser en autonomie (7 jours de deadline)

  3. Entretien technique / code review avec notre équipe tech (1h)

  4. Entretien avec le CTO (40 min)

A la fin du processus de recrutement, une rencontre plus informelle de 20 minutes peut être organisée afin de rencontrer tes futurs collègues.

Télétravail :

Environ 100 de nos collaborateurs travaillent en full remote, depuis différentes régions. Pour celles et ceux qui résident à proximité de nos locaux, une présence quotidienne est privilégiée (avec un jour de télétravail par semaine). Les personnes situées à environ une heure de route viennent généralement deux jours par semaine sur site.

Pour les collaborateurs en full remote, nous organisons une semaine de présence par trimestre, prise en charge par l’entreprise, afin de renforcer les liens avec l’équipe et de partager les temps forts de la vie interne.

Ces semaines s’inscrivent dans notre rythme d’événements trimestriels (ateliers, moments conviviaux, séminaires, etc.), qui participent à la cohésion et à la culture d’équipe.

En résumé, nous adaptons le rythme de télétravail à la situation géographique de chacun, dans un esprit de flexibilité, de confiance et de collaboration.

Rémunération et avantages

  • 40–50k€ brut annuel en fonction de l’expérience/niveau technique

  • CDI cadre – 37h/semaine

  • Prime de vacances

  • Chèques cadeaux, culture, rentrée scolaire

  • Cours de musique sur site

  • Événements d’équipe toute l’année

Arbeitsmodell: Hybrid – bis zu 2 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche
Anstellung: Vollzeit | unbefristet
Reisetätigkeit: gering und planbar

Deine neue Herausforderung

Für ein international aufgestelltes Unternehmen aus dem Pharma- und Healthcare-Umfeld suchen wir einen Project Manager Business Solutions SAP SD (m/w/d).

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du eine zentrale Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen Business und IT und verantwortest geschäftskritische SAP-Projekte mit Schwerpunkt auf Sales & Distribution (SAP SD / S/4HANA).

Du arbeitest international, steuerst interne und externe Stakeholder und gestaltest aktiv die Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Systemlandschaften mit.

Besonders spannend: Im Bereich SAP SD übernimmst du ein hohes Maß an fachlicher Eigenverantwortung und hast direkten Einfluss auf internationale Business-Prozesse und zukünftige Systemlösungen.

Aufgaben

  • Leitung und Steuerung internationaler IT- und SAP-Projekte
  • Verantwortung für SAP-Lösungen mit Schwerpunkt auf SAP SD und S/4HANA
  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung der IT-Landschaft für die Bereiche Sales & Distribution
  • Übersetzung fachlicher Anforderungen in tragfähige IT- und Lösungskonzepte
  • Steuerung des Demand-Management-Prozesses von der Anforderung über Prüfung und Freigabe bis zur Umsetzung
  • Koordination und Steuerung externer Systemintegratoren und SAP-Dienstleister
  • Beauftragung von Maintenance, Customizing, Weiterentwicklungen und Fehlerbehebungen
  • Auswahl und Steuerung externer Anbieter inklusive Aufwand-, Budget- und Kostenabschätzung
  • Verantwortung für Stakeholder- und Change-Management innerhalb der Projekte
  • Unterstützung bei der Harmonisierung internationaler Geschäftsprozesse und Systeme
  • Aufbau einer engen Zusammenarbeit über Länder, Funktionen und Fachbereiche hinweg
  • Bewertung neuer Technologien und Beratung interner Stakeholder hinsichtlich geeigneter IT-Lösungen
  • Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung globaler Templates, Prozesse und Business Solutions

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren IT-, SAP- oder Business-Solutions-Rolle
  • Praktische Berufserfahrung mit SAP SD
  • Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA
  • Erfahrung in komplexeren Unternehmens- oder Konzernstrukturen
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis für die Schnittstelle zwischen Business-Anforderungen und technischen Lösungen
  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Stakeholder-Management
  • Strukturierte, selbstständige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Hohe Serviceorientierung und Verantwortungsbewusstsein
  • Freude daran, komplexe Fragestellungen eigenständig voranzutreiben
  • Deutsch mindestens B2
  • Englisch mindestens B2 / Business Level
  • Bereitschaft, regelmäßig vor Ort in Berlin zu arbeiten

NICE TO HAVE

  • Erfahrung als Template Responsible oder Scenario Owner
  • Kenntnisse in Projekt- oder Change-Management-Methoden, z. B. Scrum oder PMP
  • Kenntnisse in SAP MM
  • Italienischkenntnisse

Benefits

Das erwartet dich

  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung für internationale und geschäftskritische SAP-Projekte
  • Zentrale Rolle als SAP-SD-Experte innerhalb des Teams
  • Großer Gestaltungsspielraum bei Prozessen, Systemen und zukünftigen Lösungen
  • Internationale Zusammenarbeit innerhalb einer etablierten Unternehmensgruppe
  • Spannende Schnittstellenfunktion zwischen Business, IT und externen Technologiepartnern
  • Möglichkeit, an Pilotprojekten mitzuwirken, die später international ausgerollt werden
  • Langfristig orientierter und stabiler Arbeitgeber
  • Teamorientierte Unternehmenskultur mit intensivem Wissensaustausch
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Modernes Hybridmodell mit bis zu 2 Homeoffice-Tagen pro Woche
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Gleitzeit
  • Überstundenausgleich
  • Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld
  • Bonusmöglichkeiten
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • Essenszuschuss
  • Corporate Benefits
  • Strukturiertes Onboarding mit Welcome Days sowie Buddy- bzw. Mentorenprogramm
  • Kontinuierliche Trainings- und Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Langfristige Karriere- und Entwicklungsperspektiven

Das Unternehmen

Unser Mandant ist Teil einer international tätigen Unternehmensgruppe aus dem Pharma- und Healthcare-Sektor.

Vom Standort Berlin aus werden unter anderem zentrale IT-, Business-, Logistik-, Finanz- und weitere Corporate-Service-Funktionen für internationale Gesellschaften unterstützt.

Das Umfeld verbindet die Stabilität eines langjährig etablierten Unternehmens mit internationalen Projekten, modernen Technologien und der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung globaler Geschäftsprozesse.

Klingt interessant?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deinen Lebenslauf.

Besonders interessant sind für uns Informationen zu deinen bisherigen SAP-SD-Projekten, deiner Rolle innerhalb der Projekte sowie deiner Erfahrung mit S/4HANA, Stakeholdern und externen Implementierungspartnern.

jobs.title: Junior Product Manager - Growth Platform (m/f/d)
Product Manager (parental leave cover)
jobs.description:
About Tandem

Tandem is the leading global language learning community, with over 35 million members from all around the world practicing languages together. The concept of learning from each other is not only core to the Tandem community, it is also at the heart of how we work every day at Tandem.


We are based in Berlin, profitable and growing, and backed by top European investors. We are highly international and driven by a shared passion for languages, technology, and culture. Together, we are on a mission to connect the world through languages, by building a product that helps people not just learn, but truly understand each other across cultures.


We are looking for a bright, data-driven, collaborative operator to help us improve the experience of our members. 


Your role will be to:

  • Run the experiment loop: hypothesis, spec, launch, readout, ship or kill. Keep a steady cadence of live tests.

  • Find the next bets from data, research, and member feedback - not from a backlog of random ideas.

  • Spec and land a small number of features with design and engineering; you are accountable for the outcome, not the ticket.

  • Share results in a way the rest of Tandem can act on.


You are the right fit for the role if you:

  • Have 3+ years of product management experience, including consumer mobile apps at scale.

  • Are analytical: you know the metrics that matter, can reason about experiments and statistical results, and are fluent in product analytics.

  • Have a proactive, independent way of working, with leadership and ownership you can point to - not only ideas, but things you shipped.

  • Are a clear communicator and a strong collaborator, with excellent written and spoken English.

  • Care about simple, intuitive user experiences and can work closely with design to get there.

  • Like hard problems and stay with them until they are solved.

  • Use AI in your own work to move faster, and are thoughtful about where it belongs in product operations.


The benefits


Passion for languages: 

We’re a team of 30 people speaking 20 languages fluently between us. For those wanting to improve their German (or Denglisch!), you can join one of our German classes on us.


Take a deep dive: 

As a Tandem team member, we’ll give you a budget for up to 6 “Deep Dive Days” per year. Pick a topic you’ve always wanted to explore for your professional development that has never made it out of your backlog. Then book a cabin in the woods or whatever matches your individual learning style.


Teams who train together, stay together: 

We offer Urban Sports Club gym memberships to boost our team’s physical and mental health. If you prefer, we can contribute to your monthly public transport ticket instead.


It takes a team to Tandem: 

Bonding with our teammates outside of our normal work routine is important to us. We organize regular team events: from day trips to monthly lunches, summer BBQs, and movie nights.


Balance matters: 

Life isn’t just about work. We know when to snooze Slack notifications, recharge our batteries, and take time out for our personal hobbies. As home office has become the new normal for some of us, it’s even more important to be able to switch off from work and relax.


Modern family: 

As part of our family-friendly company philosophy, we embrace flexible working hours, welcome families to our events, and love for our kids to visit the office and get a taste of life at Tandem.


Relocation without the stress: 

If you’re looking to relocate to Berlin, we’re ready to assist you with the infamous German bureaucracy. Many of us have been through it before, so we have plenty of tips to share. You’ll feel settled in no time.


Hybrid by design: 

We’re all about embracing a flexible, modern way of working. That’s why we focus on a hybrid approach—balancing time between our vibrant Berlin-Mitte office and the comfort of your home. It’s the best of both worlds, and we’ll support you in creating the perfect setup for this dynamic way of working.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins. 

We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling.

As Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x), this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value. Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting.

If you're energized by fast-moving markets, complex technical systems, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Own:

  • Technical product strategy & vision Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities.

  • Discovery, scoping & prioritization You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately.

  • Agile ownership & delivery You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work.

  • Technical stakeholder alignment You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle.

  • Experimentation & continuous improvement You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and technical improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up.


What You Bring

  • Technical Product Manager experience Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations.

  • Engineering fluency You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer.

  • Agile ownership You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus.

  • Data-driven product decisions Solid experience using quantitative data, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and product analytics tools to guide decisions. You understand how data is collected, structured, and interpreted, and can define instrumentation requirements yourself.

  • High-scale product teams At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users.

  • Discovery & problem solving Strong analytical and structured thinking skills. You can break down complex technical and product problems, identify root causes, and drive toward clear, testable solutions.

  • Ownership mindset You unblock teams, remove ambiguity, and take accountability for outcomes, not just outputs. You're persistent, solution-oriented, and comfortable making calls with incomplete information.

  • Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences Outstanding at adapting communication style: precise and detailed with engineers, strategic and impact-focused with leadership and business stakeholders.

  • Structured & organized Able to manage multiple workstreams, balance competing priorities, and deliver against realistic timelines without losing sight of the bigger picture


How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.

  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.

  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.

  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.

  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.


Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

jobs.title: Senior Delivery Manager, WebShop
jobs.description:
About the Role

Xsolla is looking for a Senior Delivery Manager to help bring greater clarity, coordination, and operational discipline across our product development teams.

This role sits at the center of product execution, working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Analytics, Marketing, and other Delivery Managers to ensure teams are aligned on priorities, dependencies, timelines, and changes.

The Senior Delivery Manager will own the operating rhythm of the team: maintaining the backlog and roadmap, running engineering ceremonies, surfacing risks and blockers, and ensuring that changes are communicated clearly—not just what is changing, but why.

Beyond day-to-day delivery, this person will also play an important role in identifying broader operational challenges and working with leadership to improve how the team plans, communicates, prioritizes, and executes.


Key Responsibilities

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, Analytics, Marketing, Project Managers, and other stakeholders to ensure alignment across initiatives.

  • Maintain visibility into dependencies, timelines, priorities, and risks across teams.

  • Proactively identify areas where teams are becoming misaligned and drive the conversations necessary to resolve them.

  • Ensure stakeholders understand both what the team is doing and how individual activities connect to broader product and business priorities.

    • Team Execution & Scrum

  • Run and facilitate engineering scrum ceremonies, including stand-ups, sprint planning, refinement, retrospectives, and other working sessions as needed.

  • Ensure teams leave meetings with clear decisions, owners, and next steps.

  • Track blockers and risks through resolution rather than simply documenting them.

  • Help create a predictable and effective operating cadence between Product and Engineering.

    • Backlog & Roadmap Management

  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve the team backlog and roadmap in partnership with Product and Engineering leadership.

  • Ensure work is clearly prioritized, appropriately structured, and visible to stakeholders.

  • Maintain clarity between committed roadmap work, future opportunities, operational improvements, and unscheduled backlog items.

  • Identify dependencies, sequencing challenges, and resource conflicts before they become delivery issues.

    • Change Management & Communication

  • Communicate changes to priorities, timelines, scope, and direction clearly and proactively.

  • Help teams understand the why behind changes so that Engineers, Designers, and other stakeholders have the context necessary to make better decisions.

  • Ensure important decisions and changes are documented and communicated consistently across impacted teams.

  • Help reduce confusion caused by fragmented or inconsistent communication.

    • Operational Improvement

  • Identify recurring execution challenges, process breakdowns, organizational friction, and operational gaps.

  • Work with leadership to understand root causes and define strategies for addressing them.

  • Translate operational strategies into actionable improvements for the team.

  • Continuously evaluate how planning, prioritization, communication, and execution processes can be improved.

  • Encourage accountability across teams and help ensure problems are driven toward resolution rather than passed between functions.


    • What Success Looks Like

    Success in this role means teams have greater clarity and predictability in how they operate.

    The right candidate will help create an environment where:

  • Teams understand what the highest priorities are and why.

  • Product, Engineering, Design, Analytics, and Marketing remain aligned as plans evolve.

  • Roadmaps and backlogs accurately reflect the work of the team.

  • Risks and dependencies are surfaced early rather than discovered late.

  • Changes are communicated clearly and with appropriate context.

  • Meetings result in decisions and action rather than additional ambiguity.

  • Operational problems are identified proactively and systematically improved.

  • Leadership has confidence in the team’s ability to execute against its commitments.


    • Skills & Experience

    Strong Communication

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.

  • Able to communicate effectively across technical, product, creative, and business teams.

  • Comfortable facilitating discussions involving competing priorities or viewpoints.

  • Able to simplify complex situations and provide teams with clear direction and context.

    • Highly Organized

  • Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, dependencies, stakeholders, and timelines simultaneously.

  • Strong attention to detail while maintaining awareness of broader strategic priorities.

  • Comfortable creating structure in environments where processes or responsibilities may not yet be clearly defined.

    • Diligent & Proactive

  • Does not wait for problems to become urgent before addressing them.

  • Proactively identifies risks, gaps, dependencies, and areas of confusion.

  • Consistently follows through on decisions, commitments, and open items.

  • Takes ownership of driving issues toward resolution.

    • Strategic & Operational Thinking

  • Able to distinguish between isolated execution problems and broader systemic challenges.

  • Comfortable working with leadership to improve how teams operate.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and an ability to identify root causes rather than treating symptoms.

  • Able to balance immediate delivery needs with longer-term improvements to team effectiveness.


    • Preferred Experience

  • Significant experience in Project Management, Program Management, Product Operations, or a similar role within a technology or software organization.

  • Experience working closely with Product Management and Engineering teams.

  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum development practices.

  • Experience managing product roadmaps, engineering backlogs, and cross-functional dependencies.

  • Experience working in complex organizations with multiple teams and stakeholders.

  • Experience in gaming, payments, e-commerce, or technology platforms is a plus.

All checks will comply with local regulations, and your information will be handled confidentially. jobs.title: Product Manager - Financial Services
jobs.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our Financial Services product team.
Together, you'll be driving the vision and execution of Mirakl's Financial Services products — from payments to embedded banking — to deliver outstanding value to marketplace operators and sellers worldwide.
 

Your Impact

Day-to -day, you will define with the Financial Services team the short and long-term roadmap for features within your scope:

  • Identify new features and evolve existing ones to improve our clients' performance
  • Build and maintain market and product analyses to identify functional gaps and investments to be made
  • Manage, prioritize and optimize the functional backlog for the development team
  • Collect customer feedback and anticipate their future needs
  • Champion AI-native product practices: use our AI stack (Claude Cowork, Gemini, Dust, n8n) across discovery, spec writing and delivery, and proactively propose process improvements to increase the squad's velocity and quality.

Collaborate and act as an ambassador with stakeholders:

  • The Engineering Manager and development squad during design workshops
  • Legal and business teams to launch the most viable solutions possible
  • Data Science and Product Design teams to imagine new intelligent features and integrate them into the existing product ecosystem
  • Marketing and Go To Market teams to drive launches, create and contribute to internal and external training and support materials
  • Product and Recruitment teams to participate in recruiting and coaching Product Managers at Mirakl to nurture our Product culture

What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • 4–6+ years of experience in Product Management
  • Proven track record within a SaaS software company
  • Significant experience with financial products and processes: factoring/cash advances, billing and collection mechanisms, payment systems, lending platforms, and embedded banking integrations
  • Hands-on familiarity with API design and integration ecosystems
  • Bonus: experience in a marketplace environment

Skills:
  • Product roadmap ownership & backlog prioritization
  • Financial product expertise (payments, lending, embedded banking)
  • Data-driven decision-making
  • Stakeholder communication & cross-functional collaboration
  • Agile methodologies (SCRUM, Kanban)
 

Tech Stack

Product Management : ProductBoard, Heap Analytics, Jira, Figma, Hotjar, Zendesk, Slack, Google Suite
AI : Claude Cowork, Google Gemini, Dust, n8n
 

Languages

  • French: Full professional proficiency
  • English: Full professional proficiency

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.
  1. A 30-minute phone call with one of our Tech Recruiters to discuss your background, your expectations, and discover more about Mirakl
  2. A 45-minute Google Meet meeting with the Hiring Manager to dive into the concrete aspects of your expertise and explore how your skills integrate into our projects
  3. Two 45-minute Google Meet meetings with the Engineering Manager and future colleagues to discuss our values and company culture

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews.

jobs.title: Product Owner (all genders) - Management Suite Tribe
jobs.description:
Welcome to baramundi!

“Where security, automation and centralized control come together, modern endpoint management begins.”

Do you want to actively shape modern UEM solutions, translate technical complexity into clear product decisions and create real value for IT administrators together with strong development teams? Then become part of our Management Suite Tribe and help drive the further development of our primarily on-premise Unified Endpoint Management solution as a Product Owner.

At baramundi, we develop software solutions that enable companies to centrally manage, secure and automate their endpoints. As a Product Owner, you work closely with development, Product Management, Support, Consulting and our customers in an agile, interdisciplinary environment. Your goal: to translate product requirements into valuable, prioritized and actionable features.


Do what you do best:

  • DRIVE PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT IN THE MANAGEMENT SUITE TRIBE You take content responsibility for two development squads and, together with them, further develop key product areas of the baramundi Management Suite, primarily in Windows Endpoint Management – from fundamental client-server communication to compliance and defense management, Windows OS installation, co-management and Windows Update Management. You are part of the Product Owner Chapter and work closely within the leadership trio of Chapter Lead, Scrum Master and Product Owner.
  • TRANSLATE REQUIREMENTS INTO CLEAR PRODUCT INCREMENTS You understand technical and functional complexity, formulate features and product backlog items precisely and ensure clear, testable acceptance criteria. You prioritize the product backlog based on customer value, effort, dependencies and stakeholder input.
  • DELIVER WITH YOUR TEAMS You are the primary contact person for content-related and product-related questions from your development teams, make progress transparent and ensure that your squads can work in a focused, informed and empowered way. At the same time, you balance maintenance, quality and new features.
  • BE THE BRIDGE BETWEEN PRODUCT, DEVELOPMENT AND STAKEHOLDERS You work closely with Product Management, Support, Consulting, customers as well as internal and external development partners, actively gather feedback and translate requirements into concrete development steps. In doing so, you represent product value just as clearly as the perspective of your teams.
  • COORDINATE EXTERNAL PROJECTS AND DEVELOPMENT SERVICES You coordinate external teams and projects from a content perspective, ensure clear requirements, transparent alignment and reliable integration into product development.
  • USE AI MEANINGFULLY IN YOUR PRODUCT OWNER ROUTINE You use AI tools in a reflective and pragmatic way – for example when creating features and PBIs, structuring requirements or developing quick prototypes for stakeholder feedback.


What we appreciate about you:

  • Several years of experience as a Product Owner or in a comparable role with product responsibility in an agile software development environment.
  • Experience in providing content leadership for multiple development teams as well as integrating and coordinating external projects or developers.
  • Confidence working with Scrum, Kanban and backlog tools – ideally Azure DevOps – as well as experience in scaled agile ways of working.
  • Solid knowledge of or strong interest in Unified Endpoint Management, Client Lifecycle Management and Windows-based IT infrastructures.
  • Ability to quickly understand technical complexity and translate it into clear, prioritizable requirements.
  • Analytical, data-based decision-making and a high standard of quality.
  • Strong communication skills in German and English and enjoyment in working with different stakeholders.
  • Ability to provide content leadership at eye level, create orientation and foster open, transparent exchange within the team.
  • Bonus: background in IT administration, practical knowledge of software development, experience with the Azure technology stack or touchpoints with Linux, macOS, Android or iOS.


Meet us!


10 reasons to choose baramundi!

#1 ARRIVE IN PEACE
Our all-inclusive package makes starting particularly easy. Your personal onboarding buddy will show you everything: from the welcome breakfast to the fully equipped workplace.

#2 FEEL AT HOME
Coffee, fruit, and drinks are free. We take care of your mail and packages. Once a month, all baramundians meet during work hours for pizza and chatting. Just because.

#3 EXPERIENCE VALUE AND APPRECIATION
We believe in values and live them: togetherness and trust. Courage, enthusiasm, and competence. Our communication culture is open and honest. Just like the regular team feedback sessions.

#4 GET REWARDED

jobs.description:
Das sind wir

An mehreren Standorten in Europa arbeiten unsere Teams täglich daran, Versandprozesse nachhaltig zu vereinfachen. Wir setzen auf offene Zusammenarbeit sowie kurze Entscheidungswege und suchen Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen, Ideen einbringen und aktiv mitgestalten möchten.

Deine Rolle

Als (Technical) Product Owner (m/w/d) bist du Teil unseres Product Teams und übernimmst Verantwortung für zentrale technische Schnittstellen und Integrationen unserer Plattformen. Dein Fokus liegt insbesondere auf unseren Customer APIs, der Unified Carrier Interface (UCI) sowie perspektivisch der Unified Financial Platform (UFP) und unserer HubSpot-Integration.

Dabei bewegst du dich an der Schnittstelle zwischen Product, Engineering und Business. Du verstehst technische Zusammenhänge, übersetzt unterschiedliche Anforderungen in klare Prioritäten und sorgst gemeinsam mit unseren Teams dafür, dass unsere Integrationen zuverlässig funktionieren und sich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln.

Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Product Ownern, unserem Technical Business Analyst, Software Engineers und Data Insights zusammen und bist gleichzeitig wichtige Ansprechperson für interne Stakeholder, Kunden, Carrier und externe Partner.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Roadmap unserer Customer APIs für LMS Enterprise und LMS Next und entwickelst diese strategisch weiter.
  • Du treibst die Migration unserer API-Kunden von LMS Enterprise zu LMS Next voran und identifizierst, welche Features und Carrier-Integrationen dafür benötigt werden.
  • Du bist technische Ansprechperson für unsere API-Kunden und unterstützt bei Fragen sowie bei der Analyse und Lösung von Problemen.
  • Du verantwortest gemeinsam mit internen und externen Stakeholdern die Weiterentwicklung unserer Unified Carrier Interface (UCI).
  • Du analysierst Anforderungen an Carrier-Features und Services, bereitest diese für unser Engineering auf und unterstützt QA bei der Definition relevanter Test Cases.
  • Du stehst im direkten Austausch mit unseren Carriern und klärst technische Anforderungen und Besonderheiten rund um deren Integrationen.
  • Nach dem Go-live übernimmst du die Verantwortung für unsere Unified Financial Platform (UFP) und steuerst deren Backlog und Weiterentwicklung.
  • Du behältst unsere bestehende HubSpot-Integration im Blick und priorisierst Anpassungen entsprechend neuer Business-Anforderungen und Feedbacks.
  • Über alle Themen hinweg bringst du Engineering, Business Stakeholder, Carrier und externe Partner zusammen und sorgst für klare Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Entscheidungen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du verfügst über einen technischen Hintergrund, beispielsweise in Software Engineering oder Informatik, oder hast bereits mehrere Jahre an der Schnittstelle zwischen Product und Engineering gearbeitet.
  • Du bringst Erfahrung als Product Owner oder Product Manager mit – idealerweise im Umfeld von APIs, Plattformen oder technischen Integrationen.
  • Du hast ein gutes Verständnis von APIs, API Design, Versionierung und Migrationsstrategien und kannst technische Diskussionen mit unseren Engineers auf Augenhöhe führen.
  • Du kannst komplexe technische Zusammenhänge verstehen und sie für unterschiedliche Stakeholder verständlich übersetzen.
  • Du bist sicher im Stakeholder Management und kannst unterschiedliche technische und wirtschaftliche Anforderungen gegeneinander abwägen und priorisieren.
  • Mehrere parallele Workstreams und wechselnde Prioritäten bringen dich nicht aus dem Konzept – du behältst den Überblick und setzt klare Schwerpunkte.
  • Du arbeitest gerne kollaborativ und standortübergreifend mit Kollegen in Hamburg und Naarden zusammen.
  • Du interessierst dich für AI Tools und digitale Lösungen und probierst gerne neue Wege aus, um Prozesse und Workflows effizienter zu gestalten.
  • Erfahrung in Logistik, Parcel oder Freight Tech, insbesondere mit Carrier-API-Integrationen, ist ein Plus.
  • Kenntnisse rund um HubSpot bzw. CRM-Integrationen oder Finanz- und Invoicing Systeme sind ebenfalls von Vorteil.

Warum ITA Logistics Group?

Bei uns erwartet dich ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem neue Ideen ausdrücklich willkommen sind und Feedback nicht nur erlaubt, sondern erwünscht ist. Wir hinterfragen Bestehendes, arbeiten agil und entwickeln uns kontinuierlich weiter. Dazu gehört für uns auch der Einsatz moderner digitaler Tools und KI-Anwendungen, die deinen Arbeitsalltag sinnvoll unterstützen und Prozesse effizienter machen.

  • Solid SQL in a backend context: schema design, query optimization, migrations in production. We run MySQL and ClickHouse.
  • Testing as a habit: you actually write tests, including e2e (Cypress/Playwright).
  • Architectural judgment: you design APIs from the consumer's perspective and understand how those choices shape data flow and latency across the stack.

  • Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment.
