  • Agree clear ownership and service levels for work that moves to other teams (for example, NDAs, supplier and financial forms, payment term changes, and downgrade/churn processing), so handovers actually stick.

  • Build performance metrics and reporting to track deal velocity, team output, and the impact of process and automation improvements over time.

  • Represent Deal Desk as a trusted, credible partner in cross-functional forums and with Sales leadership.

Lead the team and run point on complex deals

  • Build, lead, and develop a team of Deal Desk professionals, setting clear goals and performance standards as the team matures into a more strategic function.

  • Act as a coach-player: personally run point on Perk's most complex, highest-value deals, modelling the standard of deal structuring, negotiation support, and stakeholder management expected of the team.

  • Own pricing governance and deal structuring for complex, non-standard commercial deals, balancing commercial risk with deal velocity.

  • Mentor the team on complex deal structuring, pricing strategy, and commercial risk judgement, and coach them through escalations.

  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Sales Operations, and Product to unblock deals and resolve cross-functional friction quickly.

Own our systems and quoting experience

  • Own the relationship with our CPQ platform end to end, bringing prior experience owning a complex CPQ implementation elsewhere.

  • Identify and drive improvements to CPQ configuration, pricing logic, and quoting workflows so Sales can quote and close faster with confidence.

  • Act as the primary Deal Desk voice in Revenue Systems and CPQ/CLM tooling roadmap decisions.

Drive automation and AI

  • Own the automation roadmap for Deal Desk, with a clear mandate to remove manual, repetitive work from the team through AI and automation.

  • Prioritise and deliver automation of the highest-impact manual workflows first, such as company and payment profile setup and post-signature subscription provisioning, which today account for a significant share of the team's ticket volume.

  • Partner with engineering/systems teams to scope, sequence, and deliver automation initiatives, and track the time saved and volume shifted off manual processing.

  • Evaluate and pilot AI tools for use cases such as contract redline review, NDA triage, and deal risk flagging, working closely with Legal.

Protect the business

  • Act as Deal Desk's first line of defense on contract redlines and non-standard deal terms, escalating to Legal or Finance where needed.

  • Own commercial governance frameworks, pricing and discounting policy, and approval structures across the function.

  • Safeguard deal commercials, business risk, and revenue recognition implications on complex and non-standard deals.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong Deal Desk experience within B2B SaaS, ideally spanning mid-market and enterprise segments.

  • Proven experience leading a Deal Desk (or equivalent commercial/sales operations) team, with direct people management responsibility.

  • A genuine coach-player: comfortable personally running complex, high-value deals while simultaneously leading and developing a team.

  • Prior ownership of a complex CPQ platform, with a track record of driving measurable improvements to quoting, pricing, and deal velocity for Sales.

  • Experience scoping and delivering automation and/or AI initiatives that reduce manual operational work, ideally in partnership with engineering or systems teams.

  • Strong cross-functional stakeholder management skills, comfortable partnering across Legal, Finance, Sales Operations, and Product.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-changing, ambiguous environment where processes are still being defined and improved.


What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk.

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays.

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex.

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva.

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen.

  • Rest assured that you're covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence.

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus.

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party.

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones.

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks' paid parental leave.

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes.

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year.

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards.

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years.

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support.

AI at Perk

AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled, so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

We don't expect you to be an AI expert, but we do expect you to be curious and intentional about it. The bar is judgment: knowing when AI makes your work better, when to verify what it produces, and when to rely on your own expertise instead.

We'll ask about how you use AI in your interviews, not to test tool knowledge, but to understand how you think about it. That reflects how we work every day.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

You'll be part of our EMEA Account Management team led by Stanislas Joly, VP Account Management Global. The team consists of 5 Account Managers, each managing a portfolio of enterprise clients across different EMEA markets. Together, you'll be driving growth and retention for Mirakl's most strategic clients across the region, while regularly exchanging best practices and deal learnings with your counterparts in the AMER account management team.

  • Develop and execute account plans that align client business objectives with Mirakl's roadmap, unlocking expansion opportunities across multiple markets and business units

  • Stay ahead of industry trends and the competitive landscape to proactively address client challenges and position Mirakl as the definitive platform of choice

Experience:
  • 8+ years in account management, sales roles managing global or strategic accounts in a SaaS or technology environment
  • Proven track record of driving revenue growth through upsell and cross-sell motions with complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise clients
  • Experience working in an international context, with the ability to navigate cultural nuances across EMEA markets
Skills:
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to design and execute long-term account plans that create mutual value
  • Strong business acumen to understand complex client business models and connect them to Mirakl's solutions

You will own the part of nebenan.de that neighbors actually see and touch. Concretely, you will:

Own your product area

  • Own a product area end to end. From prototype through production to iteration, mobile-first. You decide from usage data what to improve next and keep the area healthy on an ongoing basis.

  • Run what you build. Set and meet performance and reliability targets for your area, instrument before shipping, and handle incidents in your own work.

  • Challenge the plan. You work with a product lead who owns the outcome and a product analyst who designs and validates experiments. If a piece of work won't move the metric it's meant to move, say so early.


Build the interface

  • Build React features are accessible, fast, and consistent with our design system.

  • Own and extend the design system. Components, tokens, and patterns that other engineers reuse. You push generic work into shared components early.

  • Work across the client–server boundary. Shape the APIs your screens depend on; make deliberate choices about data fetching, caching, loading, and error states; and understand what's happening on the network.


Work with AI and evidence

  • Direct AI and be accountable for what it writes. You set intent, review what comes back, and own everything that ships under your name.

  • Replace manual QA with evidence. Automated tests, visual regression, and instrumentation ground your confidence in data.


What this role is not

  • Not a ticket taker. You own working software in production, not merged pull requests.

  • Not pixel-pushing behind a designer. Design and validation of the experience sit with product and design; building it into production software and pushing back on it are yours.

  • Not frontend-only in practice. Depth in the frontend, contribution across the stack.


Your profile

  • Strong React in production: component design, state management, rendering behaviour

  • A real grasp of client–server architecture: how the browser and the backend actually talk, what that costs, and how it fails

  • Craft in the fundamentals: modern CSS and layout, semantic HTML, accessibility, web performance, responsive and mobile-first work

  • Solid command of TypeScript

  • Experience building or maintaining a design system, or at least a clear opinion about what makes one work

  • Comfortable owning outcomes, working day to day with non-engineers

  • A maker: ships, validates, then refines on what the evidence shows

  • Cares that the thing works for the person using it, on their phone, on their network

  • A plus: enough backend familiarity (Ruby, or any server-side language) to change an endpoint yourself

  • A plus: data-informed product work, with decisions grounded in data

  • English skills for working in our international team; German is a plus


What we offer

  • Hybrid work model combining office and remote days 

  • A meaningful job – we're creating a great product with real added value for the community

  • Work in a cheerful and experienced team that exchanges ideas and learns from each other

  • Insights into the entire work process of our social startup and the nebenan.de foundation

jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment.

Where 50 Billion Daily Predictions Begin

The User Experience team is the origin point of adjoe Ads. Everything the system knows about a user, every prediction the ML models make, every bid placed in an auction. It all starts with code this team ships.

The team owns two responsibilities. On the SDK side, a native Kotlin and Swift code runs inside hundreds of publisher apps. It participates in 120 million daily auctions, renders ad creatives across multiple formats, and captures the behavioral signals that power 50 billion predictions per day. The constraint that defines this work: you're executing inside someone else's app, on someone else's device, with zero tolerance for instability. Every ad impression has to feel native and fast to the user.

On the analytics side, the dashboards, investigation tools, and data frameworks that turn raw data into decisions: real-time revenue performance across active campaigns, infrastructure cost visibility, and data quality assessments. If a number matters to the business or to engineering, this team makes it accessible.

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer (Full-stack)
jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to build the platform that catches data problems before they become business problems.

About Us

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing.

Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo.

The Role

You'll lead frontend work in one of our product teams: a TypeScript/Angular application with Storybook-driven components and Cypress e2e coverage, in front of a Java backend. You own the user experience end-to-end, from component architecture and state management down to the API shape, because the backend is yours to touch too. We're product engineers, not ticket-takers: you'll talk to users, shape the design with your PM, and ship without waiting for hand-offs.

Frontend is your craft; full-stack is your reach. You'll spend most of your time in the frontend, and you can ship a backend endpoint when the feature needs it rather than filing a ticket and waiting. We also build agentically: AI coding agents are part of the daily workflow here, not an experiment on the side.

What You'll Do

  • Own complex, data-dense UIs: dashboards, monitoring views, large tables, diffs and drill-downs that stay fast and legible.
  • Drive component architecture, state management, and frontend performance.
  • Build with a component library and Storybook; keep the design system coherent as the product grows.
  • Write tests at every layer. You'll help keep our Cypress e2e suite meaningful.
  • Build the frontend of agentic features: interfaces where users direct, review, and act on LLM-powered workflows.
  • Improve our systems for agentic development on the frontend: conventions, Storybook coverage, and tests that agents can build against reliably.
  • Shape the APIs you consume, and implement backend changes (Java) when your feature needs them.
  • Mentor backend-focused engineers on frontend, helping the team grow more full-stack and deliver features end to end.
  • Work directly with product, design, and customers to decide what to build. Your opinion matters here.

Hiring Process

  1. CV screen
  2. 20-minute phone screen
  3. First technical interview (45 min)
  4. Second technical interview (60 min)
  5. Culture fit (45 min)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

  • 5+ years building frontend for real products: complex single-page applications with real users, not just marketing sites.
  • Expert TypeScript and deep experience with a modern framework: Angular preferred (it's what powers Soda Cloud); strong React/Vue engineers willing to work in Angular are welcome.
  • Frontend craft: component architecture, state management, rendering performance, responsive design, and an eye for detail (you can spot a misaligned pixel).
  • Testing as a habit: you actually write tests, including e2e (Cypress/Playwright).
  • Working backend skills: you can read and modify a Java service, design an API from the consumer's perspective, and write competent SQL.
  • Systems insight: you understand how an API's shape drives round-trips, data flow, and perceived latency in the UI.
  • Agentic engineering: you ship production code with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) in the loop, and you know how to direct them well while keeping the quality bar high.
  • Independence: you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries.
  • Fluent English.

Good to Have

  • Data-heavy or developer-tool products: data visualization, monitoring, analytics UIs.
  • Design-system or component-library ownership.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS at scale; high-growth startup experience.
  • Python: our data engineering stack runs on it.
  • Experience building agentic workflows into the product: LLM-powered features, tool-using agents, or AI-driven automation shipped to real users.
  • Data quality, data management, data observability, or ML monitoring industry experience.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Compensation €85,000-120,000/year + equity.
  • Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • A team of senior engineers who ship, across 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it.
  • International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time.

jobs.description:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Senior QA Engineer (all genders) to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first within Germany, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations.


Contabo serves 180,000+ customers worldwide across VPS, dedicated servers, object storage and a growing cloud-native platform. Quality isn't a bottleneck function here – it's embedded in how we build.
You'll work across multiple development teams on products that vary significantly in architecture, maturity and risk profile. The scope is wide and the technical surface is real.

QA here means jumping between contexts and figuring things out, not just executing scripts against a stable codebase.
You come in before development starts: read the requirements, flag what's untestable and push back early. 
You own the test strategy and update it as things change – not as a document exercise, but because the products actually change.

You write test plans and test cases, run manual tests (functional, regression, exploratory, UAT) and build and maintain automated tests across UI, API and integration.
We use AI tools actively: in development, in testing, in how we work day to day and we expect the same from you. That's not a trend we're chasing: it's how we stay fast without cutting corners on quality.
 
You keep the continuous testing pipelines running and help the teams use them. When bugs come up, you write bug reports that developers can actually work with – reproduction steps, impact, everything needed to close it without a follow-up ping.
Regular regression cycles after major releases are part of the job, as is running UAT with product stakeholders.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with: 

  • 5+ years in software testing/QA, ideally in agile teams
  • Test automation in Python and JavaScript/TypeScript; hands-on with frameworks like Playwright, Frisby, or Supertest
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools in development or testing (AI code generators, LLM-based test support or similar) and comfortable using Claude (or comparable LLMs) as part of your daily workflow

You'll be the first dedicated product manager for this space, responsible for turning that inbound chaos into a defensible, well-communicated plan — and, over time, for building the intake, frameworks and partnerships that let the space run on systems rather than on you.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you'll be shaping tickets and sizing work alongside analysts and engineers, not managing from above.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the prioritised order of work for Core — building a clear, ranked plan, explaining the reasoning behind it, and being explicit about what's being deferred and why

  • Turn vague or incomplete partner requests into documented problems, mapped current-state processes, and testable outcomes

  • Partner directly and regularly with People Operations, Compliance, Payroll, Total Rewards and Business Systems Analysts, including holding "not now" conversations without damaging the relationship

  • Work hands-on with analysts and engineers to shape, size, and write tickets, keeping an accurate and current picture of committed, shipped, and carried-over work

  • Build and evolve the operating model across the analyst and engineering pod — the mechanisms, documentation and intake processes that let the space run with less coordination overhead

  • Use AI tools to accelerate translation of messy, multi-format, multi-language inbound requests into structured requirements and plans, while applying clear judgment about what should never be automated (anything touching pay, leave, employment status or right to work)

  • Escalate proactively on statutory or audit exposure, cross-space dependencies, and any trade-off that would move a compliance date

  • Report progress and delivery against plan to partners and leadership, including clear communication when outcomes fall short

Requirements

  • Experience owning a product or systems area end-to-end, with real decision rights over scope and sequencing — not co-ownership of a feature

  • Hands-on background with Workday or a comparable HRIS as a product manager or technical program manager, with genuine understanding of configuration, business processes, and integrations

  • Demonstrated ability to prioritise when demand structurally exceeds capacity, including a repeatable method (not just instinct) for deciding what to do and communicating what won't get done

  • Proven delivery in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, comfortable starting when requirements are incomplete or undocumented

  • Experience translating a partner's requested solution into a well-defined problem, current-state understanding, and testable outcome

  • Strong collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders, including compliance, payroll, or other regulated/audit-exposed functions

  • Practical fluency with AI tools for requirements drafting, documentation, and structuring unstructured information, paired with sound judgment about where not to apply them

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighborhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. We recognise that some candidates may require adjustments to apply for a position or fairly participate in the interview process. If you require any adjustments, please don't hesitate to let us know. We will make every effort to provide the necessary adjustments to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Windows/Desktop Applications - Frankfurt, Germany
jobs.description:
Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.  

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies

What You'll Do
  • Lead the design, architecture, and development of native Windows desktop applications using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or related UI frameworks), C#, XAML, and — when needed — C++.
  • Define and enforce best-practices for Windows desktop development across the codebase: code architecture, performance, memory usage, responsive UI, cross-version compatibility (Windows 10/11+), and maintainability.
  • Drive accessibility efforts: integrate and validate support for accessibility APIs (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or other relevant Windows accessibility frameworks), ensure UI controls, focus management, keyboard navigation, screen-reader support, and usability for users with disabilities.
  • Collaborate closely with product designers, UX researchers, QA, and other stakeholders to shape feature planning, UI/UX architecture, and long-term roadmap for the Windows platform.
  • Take ownership of full lifecycle of features: conception → design → implementation → testing → release → maintenance. Ensure quality, reliability, and consistency across releases.
  • Identify, diagnose, and resolve complex bugs, performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, rendering issues, or compatibility problems — and propose robust architectural or design solutions.
 
An ideal candidate should have

Required:

  • 3+ in Windows desktop application development using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or similar), C#, XAML — and ideally additional experience with native Windows code (C++, Win32/WinRT/COM).
  • Deep understanding of Windows application architecture, including interop between managed code (.NET) and native code.
  • Proven track record of designing, building, and shipping production-quality desktop applications, with an emphasis on reliability, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Strong experience with accessibility APIs on Windows (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or similar), and a dedication to building accessible and inclusive software.
  • Excellent software engineering fundamentals: OOP, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, memory management, multi-threading or asynchronous programming (where relevant).
  • Experience leading technical design, mentoring other engineers, conducting code reviews, and making architecture-level decisions.
  • Strong communication skills; ability to articulate tradeoffs, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and drive consensus.
  • A user-centric mindset: focus on building polished, intuitive, and accessible experiences for end users.

Preferred / Bonus:

  • Experience with writing automated tests for UI — unit tests, integration tests, UI automation tests; familiarity with relevant testing frameworks.
  • Experience with performance optimization for desktop apps (memory usage, startup time, rendering performance, high-DPI support, responsiveness under load).
  • Experience with localization/globalization, right-to-left UI support, internationalization, accessibility for multiple regions.
  • Familiarity with telemetry, analytics, crash reporting, logging, and error monitoring in desktop applications.
  • Previous experience in shaping CI/CD workflows, release pipelines, and deployment strategies for desktop applications.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership of feature areas or modules and drive them long-term, including maintenance, refactoring, and technical debt management.

What we offer

  • A high-impact role: you will define architecture, shape the future of our Windows product, and directly influence what millions of users see and experience.
  • A collaborative, flat-structure engineering culture — you are not just a coder, but a builder and a decision-maker.
  • Opportunities to lead — mentor others, steer technical direction, and grow into broader technical leadership (e.g. Tech Lead, Architect).
  • Flexibility, autonomy, and responsibility: you define how to solve problems, own features end-to-end, and contribute to long-term product vision.
  • A purpose-driven mission: building software that's reliable, accessible, and user-centered — making a real difference for people.                  

The Germany Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-120,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

À propos de Lexroom

Chez Lexroom, nous développons l’état de l’art de la recherche juridique agentique. Notre plateforme décompose chaque question juridique en sous-questions précises, puis mobilise des agents spécialisés pour explorer en parallèle les codes, jurisprudences, doctrines et textes européens. Chaque source est minutieusement analysée, les liens implicites entre principes sont identifiés, et toutes les informations sont synthétisées dans un rapport structuré, avec chaque affirmation soigneusement sourcée. Ce qui, auparavant, demandait une semaine à une équipe se réalise désormais pendant une pause café.

 

Notre mission : rendre le droit plus rapide, plus clair et plus fiable, afin que les avocats et les directions juridiques puissent se concentrer sur l’essentiel.

 

Nous sommes en train de constituer l’équipe commerciale – et vous serez parmi les tout premiers à la rejoindre.

 

Pourquoi rejoindre Lexroom ?

  • Un produit qui tient ses promesses : Nos démos sont impactantes et convainquent dès la première session – pas besoin de six mois de POC.

  • Un marché en pleine effervescence : Tous les cabinets français recherchent une solution IA, et les usages sont encore à inventer.

  • Un avantage concurrentiel fort : Vous ne vendez pas un assistant IA de plus, mais une approche radicalement nouvelle que les prospects n’ont jamais vue.

 

Vos responsabilités

  • Convertir le pipeline qualifié par les SDR/BDR : prendre le relai après qualification et mener le process jusqu’à la signature.

  • Mener des démonstrations personnalisées : comprendre la problématique du prospect, la traduire dans le produit et démontrer la valeur unique de Lexroom.

  • Négocier et closer vos deals.

  • Suivre vos KPIs : objectif d’ARR, couverture de pipeline, taux de conversion, durée de cycle, gestion rigoureuse des remises, prévisions fiables.

  • Maintenir un CRM irréprochable : pipeline à jour, prises de notes claires, forecasts fiables.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec les SDR et BDR : feedback sur la qualité des leads, ajustement des ciblages, partage des arguments les plus efficaces.

  • Remonter les insights du terrain vers le produit pour nourrir la roadmap.

 

Profil recherché

  • 1 à 3 ans d’expérience en vente B2B SaaS, comme AE ou BDR senior prêt à évoluer.

  • Excellentes compétences en entretien client : analyse des besoins, gestion de démo, maîtrise des échanges.

  • Expérience en closing : atteinte d’objectifs, gestion de négociations, résilience et suivi des prospects.

  • Capacité à gérer un volume important de deals courts en simultané.

  • Coachable : feedback direct, learning fast, capacité d’adaptation.

  • Maîtrise des outils commerciaux (HubSpot, Sales Navigator, etc).

  • Français natif, anglais courant (clientèle francophone, équipes internes internationales).

  • Intérêt pour le droit : une expérience dans le secteur juridique ou des services professionnels est un plus, mais pas indispensable.

  • Rémunération OTE : 85 000 € (55 000 € fixe + 30 000 € variable non plafonné)

jobs.title: Director of Cybersecurity & IT
jobs.description:
Hi, we’re Back Market.

We’re here to help make tech reliable, affordable, and better than new. We're a global marketplace for refurbished devices, helping lower our collective environmental impact by providing trustworthy, affordable tech with 92% less carbon emissions than new.

Yep, you read that right. Turns out refurbished tech is way better for the planet than new. In fact, With every device purchased on Back Market, our positive impact on the planet grows. From our Customer Care representatives to our software engineer, every individual at Back Market cuts the planet — and consumers — a break. Our mission is simple: to do more with what we already have.

Are you ready to join us?

Back Market is looking for a Director of Cybersecurity & IT to define and lead the next phase of our security and technology operations maturity. Reporting to the VP of Platform Engineering, you will be a strategic leader at the intersection of cybersecurity, IT, risk, compliance, and business growth.

You will lead a multi-disciplinary organization through its existing functional managers, creating the clarity, operating rhythm, and investment focus needed to protect Back Market while enabling the company to move quickly. The scope includes cybersecurity strategy and risk management, security operations, governance and compliance, IT operations, IT support, and the corporate technology foundations that keep our people productive and our business resilient.

 

This is a director-level role, not a super-sized operational manager role. You will not be expected to personally own every process or make every technical decision. Your impact will come from setting direction, developing leaders, aligning stakeholders, making sound investment choices, and ensuring that the organization delivers measurable outcomes. You will be the senior voice who makes cybersecurity and IT understandable, actionable, and connected to the business.

 

To know more about our engineering teams:

  • A video of our VP Platform: https://youtu.be/zvTlw4BNNdc

  • Our company purpose: http://bit.ly/3OsScpl

  • Our engineering blog: https://bit.ly/3ASJNID

How we work with the existing teams 💚

 

The Director sets direction, creates clarity, secures resources, removes organizational obstacles, develops leaders, and ensures that the overall portfolio delivers against agreed outcomes. The functional managers and senior experts retain ownership of day-to-day execution, technical practices, operational processes, and delivery within their domains. The Director creates the conditions for those leaders to succeed and makes sure their work adds up to a coherent company-wide strategy.

Set the strategy, roadmap, and investment priorities

  • Translate that strategy into a focused portfolio of initiatives, with clear outcomes, sequencing, ownership, dependencies, and measures of success

Lead and grow a high-performing leadership organization

  • Create clear career paths, succession plans, and development opportunities across the organization

  • Attract and retain exceptional talent, define what great leadership and execution look like, and continuously raise the bar without creating unnecessary bureaucracy

  • Ensure that responsibilities, decision rights, and interfaces between the teams are explicit, understood, and respected

 

Turn cybersecurity into a business enabler

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the VP of Engineering, CTO, Executive Committee, and senior leaders across the business

  • Explain complex security, IT, and risk topics in clear business language, including the trade-offs, options, costs, and consequences of different decisions

  • Engage with Heads of and cross-functional streams across Back Market to advocate for security and resilience in all areas of the business

  • Build alignment rather than relying on authority, and help teams adopt secure and resilient ways of working because they understand the rationale and value

  • Partner with Finance and senior technology leadership on investment cases, budget stewardship, vendor strategy, and the value delivered by the portfolio

 

Steer enterprise cyber risk and trust

  • Own the cyber risk management process at the strategic level, using the GRC framework as the foundation for security decisions and prioritization

  • Ensure that material risks, control gaps, exceptions, and remediation plans are visible, understood, and actively managed

  • Escalate critical risks when they exceed the organization's risk appetite or require executive arbitration

  • Support security compliance efforts across the organization, ensuring alignment and buy-in from peers and key stakeholders across ISO 27001, PCI DSS, GDPR, NIS2, and contractual partner requirements

  • Partner with the VP Legal and DPO on the company's data privacy strategy, ensuring privacy and security requirements are considered early in business, product, and technology decisions

  • Represent Back Market's security maturity and risk posture to investors, auditors, regulators, strategic partners, and major customers

  • Serve as the senior escalation point for major or complex security incidents, ensuring the right executive communication, decision-making, learning, and follow-through without displacing the operational ownership of the incident response teams

 

Enable secure products and resilient technology

  • Partner with Engineering, Product, and other Bureau of Technology directors to ensure security requirements are integrated into product and feature development from the beginning

Build security culture and external credibility

  • Foster a security-aware culture through clear communication about the evolving threat landscape, key initiatives, practical expectations, and the role every Back Maker plays in protecting the company

  • Sponsor awareness, education, and Security Champion programs that make secure behavior accessible and relevant to different audiences

  • Represent Back Market in relevant security communities, industry groups, partner forums, and regulatory conversations

  • Build trusted relationships with strategic technology partners, auditors, insurers, and external security providers

  • Help Back Market demonstrate that strong security, responsible technology, and business agility reinforce one another


You could be a good fit if you've:

  • Experience leading through managers and senior experts, with a genuine passion for developing people, building leadership capability, and creating meaningful career paths

  • Strong understanding of modern cloud, SaaS, identity, endpoint, application, data, and infrastructure security concepts, even if you are not the deepest technical expert in every domain

jobs.title: Product Designer (Experimentation) (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Your mission

We're looking for a designer who decides with evidence. Most design roles stop at the handover. This one does not. You will design a part of the product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and read the results yourself. If you have ever shipped a redesign and never really found out whether it worked, this is the opposite of that.

You will sit inside one product delivery leadership team, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it – not off to one side taking requests. And you will not be doing it alone: you join a group of Product Designers across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards.

English is our working language. German matters here too: you will be designing flows that German-speaking neighbours read.

Concretely, you will:

  • Design experiences that fit how people already live. Our product mirrors real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that feel natural to someone standing on their doorstep with one hand on their phone, not to add features because we can.

  • Frame the real problem before solving it. Take a vague ask, find the actual question underneath it, and make it explainable. A well framed problem to solve is half the battle.

  • Run the experiment, and read it honestly. Design a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome with our data team. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, which is most of them, and saying what you would do differently.

  • Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody.

  • Direct AI, and spend your judgment where it counts. AI produces a lot of our first-pass design. You will brief it, push back on it, and hold the quality bar, so your own hours go to the thinking a model cannot do. Polish goes where it changes behaviour, not onto every surface.

  • Argue for cutting things. Adding is easy. You will help decide what earns its place and what should be removed, and be willing to make the case for less.


Your profile

  • You practice design, and you are very comfortable with numbers. You might come from an analyst background and bring a love of design and design thinking, or vice versa.

  • You have technical know-how. You need to be able to construct the pipelines and dashboards yourself, use our experimentation platform, and our design system tooling.

  • You get your own numbers. Whether through SQL, AI-assisted querying, or both, you do not wait for someone else to pull data for you. 

  • You have run experiments end to end. Hypothesis, design, instrumentation, analysis, decision. Not just handing a mockup to someone who tested it later.

  • You care about craft and are attentive to details. You can tell the difference between good enough and actually good and you design experiences people do not have to think about.

  • You use AI as a tool already or want to. This role allows you to have more control and impact through both design and analysis, but to do this well you'll need to leverage (and at times extend) our AI enablement stack.

  • You present your work clearly, defend your decisions when challenged, and are comfortable in front of a crowd.

  • Excellent English skills for working in our international team.

To apply, share a portfolio that shows your work by impact — at least one project walked through end to end: the hypothesis, what you designed, the result, and what you took from it. Show us how you used data to move your thinking forward, and where experimentation shaped what you built. 

Nice to have

  • Experience with a marketplace, community, classifieds, or other network product. 

  • Strong German, or the confidence to design in it with support.

  • Experience building or maintaining parts of a design system. 

  • Comfortable writing SQL without AI assistance.


What we offer

  • Hybrid work model combining office and remote days 

  • A meaningful job – we're creating a great product with real added value for the community

  • Work in a cheerful and experienced team that exchanges ideas and learns from each other

  • Insights into the entire work process of our social startup and the nebenan.de foundation

  • Responsibility and great opportunities to actively contribute

  • Your nebenan.de SpenditCard – you'll receive an additional income of 35 Euros per month, which you can use for things of your choice

  • 30 days of vacation per year – we also offer the possibility of workation models and a sabbatical

  • A workplace in Berlin-Kreuzberg and regular events like yoga or Lunch & Learn sessions.


If we’ve captured your interest, apply now and let us know why you’re the perfect fit for the job!

jobs.description:
What You'll Do

You’ll identify open AI opportunities, build them from start to finish, and bring them to real users. As a Senior AI Product Engineer, you’ll work across our three product squads: You’ll single-handedly turn unaddressed topics into products, hand them off once they’re up and running, and serve as a sparring partner for the squad PMs on all AI-related topics. For us, “senior” refers to your approach to work, not your years of experience. You’ll report directly to Product Leadership.

Your Responsibilities

  • Independent AI projects (about half of your time)
  • You’ll identify high-impact AI opportunities in our legal workflows - in areas where no specific squad is responsible
  • Validation happens quickly: discussions with attorneys, Legal Ops, and insurers; prototypes built in days
  • You’ll bring the winning solutions into production yourself: routing, chaining, summarization, and agent-based loops
  • You’ll hand off mature features to the squad - complete with documentation, evaluations, and a handover plan
Support for the squads (the other half)
  • Feasibility, costs, model selection, risks: You’ll answer these questions before every AI feature is launched
  • You support the teams in designing evaluations, golden datasets, and guardrails
  • You review concepts before they go into the roadmap - including prompt injection and compliance risks (GDPR, Section 203 of the German Criminal Code)
  • You advance AI best practices: prompt engineering standards, LLM observability, and agent-based coding workflows


What you bring

Must-have

  • Multiple production-ready AI/LLM systems that you’ve shipped to real users and taken responsibility for - no prototypes
  • Demonstrable product ownership: from a vague problem to a finished product
  • Strong Python skills and a solid foundation in software engineering (Git, testing, CI/CD, code review)
  • In-depth experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or similar - including an understanding of what’s happening under the hood
  • Proficiency with LLM provider APIs: function/tool calling, structured outputs, streaming
  • Evaluations, golden datasets, and guardrails before deployment
  • Solid prompt engineering - you know when to use which technique
  • Business-level English; German is a major plus due to our legal domain
Soft Skills
  • The maturity to work without a squad around you: You set your own priorities and know when to say no
  • You can explain a technical trade-off to a lawyer and a legal workflow to an engineer


What we promise

Work Environment & Flexibility

  • Office-first: 3 days in the office, 2 days working from home - with flexibility in how you structure your work
  • Modern, air-conditioned office with plenty of natural light and a large rooftop terrace overlooking Berlin
  • Central location between Gleisdreieck and Potsdamer Platz
Benefits
  • Full coverage of the public-transport ticket
  • Company pension plan with a 20% employer contribution
  • Corporate benefits platform with discounts from many brands
  • Dog-friendly office
  • Regular company and team events, after-work fun with Switch, PS5, darts, and foosball
  • Free drinks, fresh fruit, and granola
Culture & Collaboration
  • Agile mindset with open communication - every voice counts
  • Feedback is part of our culture - we believe in growing together
Fast application process
  • Your application as an AI Product Engineer (Senior) - short and to the point
  • Approx. 20-minute introductory conversation with our HR team
  • Approx. 60-minute in-person interview with your hiring manager
  • Approx. 30-minute discussion with the management team
  • A prompt job offer

Your mission

You are the architect and builder of the customer-facing side of the LEASETEQ platform in Berlin, and the owner of our German market on it. You design the digital application journey and the portals that carry real customers, dealers and operations teams at production scale, and you make sure German credit rules, compliance requirements and dealer flows are represented correctly in a platform that also serves Switzerland and Austria. You work in a small, senior team where your decisions have direct product impact, and you naturally bring AI tooling into your daily engineering workflow without being asked.

What you will do

  • Own the German market on our customer-facing platform: credit and compliance requirements, dealer flows, German copy, and the acceptance criteria that make them verifiable
  • Design and build the digital application journey — multi-step forms, validation, resumable state, document upload, KYC steps and the unhappy paths users actually hit
  • Build and maintain the customer, dealer and operations portals, including the operations board and the logic that decides where a case belongs
  • Write the use-case and API layers behind the journey to our clean-architecture standard — this is a full-stack role, not a UI role
  • Own field-level mapping into the CRM and the Flowable-based process engine — beneficial ownership, source of funds, origin of income, additional persons — where a wrong key is a compliance defect, not a cosmetic one
  • Author specification-driven change proposals, and act as the named human approver for journey and mapping changes in the German market
  • Grow end-to-end test coverage on the critical journeys: coverage is what licenses autonomous agent work in a module
  • Work with our Berlin backend team on the seam between the orchestration core and the customer-facing platform, and with our Jakarta platform engineers who own the journey across all three markets
  • Communicate clearly in German and English with engineering peers and business stakeholders


Your profile

  • 6+ years of full-stack TypeScript engineering, with recent production work in React and Next.js App Router — server components, server actions and route handlers, with a clear grasp of what runs where — is mandatory
  • Fintech experience is mandatory: production work on a regulated financial product — leasing, lending, banking, payments or insurance — where money moved and a regulator could ask why
  • Proven ownership of a complex multi-step onboarding or application flow is mandatory: validation strategy, partial persistence and resumption, conditional branching by market or product, document upload
  • Real backend capability: use cases, repository implementations, API handlers and PostgreSQL / Prisma queries — roughly a 60/40 split toward the frontend, not 90/10
  • State and data-fetching maturity (Zustand or equivalent, TanStack Query) and confident use of form and schema tooling (Formik or React Hook Form with Zod), including server-side validation parity
  • End-to-end testing with Playwright or Cypress on flows that are slow, stateful and integration-dependent
  • AI-first engineering mindset: daily use of coding assistants and agents on production work, and the ability to write a change specification precise enough that an agent implements it correctly and a reviewer can verify that it did
  • Working understanding of the German regulatory environment for consumer credit or asset finance — BaFin-supervised context, AML/KYC obligations, consumer-credit disclosure — is a strong plus
  • Internationalisation as a habit — no hard-coded strings, and awareness of what four locales do to layout and copy
  • Fluent German and English


Why us?

  • Founding-team-level ownership of our customer-facing platform and of the German market on it
  • Direct collaboration with the CTO and the founders, including regular visits to our Swiss headquarters
  • A genuinely AI-first process, not a slogan: specification-driven delivery where agents execute approved changes and humans own scope, architecture, regulatory and release decisions
  • Hybrid setup with 2-3 days per week in our coworking office in Berlin (WeWork, Stresemannstrasse)
  • Competitive and fair salary: €70,000 - €90,000 gross per year, depending on experience and impact
  • 10–15% annual bonus tied to company performance and clear OKRs
  • Tax-free monthly benefit allowance of €50 that you can use for what you personally value
  • Sustainable mobility budget: subsidy for e-bike leasing and app-based car sharing for occasional trips
  • Additional health insurance options, including enhanced coverage for dental and vision care
  • Company-supported pension scheme with employer contributions on top of the statutory system
  • Employer-funded disability coverage starting from day one of employment
  • Dedicated AI tooling budget (e.g. Cursor, Claude API) so you can experiment and move fast
  • Modern Apple devices
  • Our remote policy promises 4 weeks & worldwide
About LEASETEQ
LEASETEQ builds the orchestration brain for mid-market car leasing and asset finance in the DACH region. Our platform automates the full contract lifecycle – from origination and credit decision through to end-of-term – using Flowable BPM as the core process engine on a modern, event-driven micro-services architecture, with a Next.js / TypeScript platform serving our customer, dealer and operations portals in four languages across Switzerland, Germany and Austria.
We are an AI-first engineering team: agents, intelligent workflows and LLM-augmented automation are how we build today, not items on a future roadmap. From our base in Switzerland, our subsidiaries in Austria and Germany and our engineering team in Jakarta, you join a small, senior team where your decisions have visible impact on customers, partners and the future of our product.

About the Role

As our Senior Partner Manager DACH, you'll own and grow Tellent's partner ecosystem across the DACH market. You'll inherit an established network of reseller and referral partners, including a group of key strategic partners with significant growth potential — and your role is to turn that foundation into a stronger, more predictable source of pipeline and revenue.

You'll build trusted relationships with key partners, create joint growth plans, identify whitespace opportunities across their customer base, and hold partners accountable for execution. At the same time, you'll identify and recruit new high-potential partners, particularly within the HR ecosystem. This is a senior individual contributor role: you'll operate with significant ownership, treating the DACH partner business almost like your own business and bringing a clear point of view on where the market can grow.

You will report to the VP Partnerships.

Your 12-Month Journey

  • During the first 3 months: You build a strong understanding of the DACH partner ecosystem, establish relationships with key partners and Sales stakeholders, and define a clear plan for where to focus your time and investment.

  • Within 6 months: You're independently managing the partner portfolio, driving joint business plans with key partners, generating quality pipeline, and identifying new partner opportunities.

  • After 1 year: You're driving predictable partner-sourced pipeline and revenue across DACH, growing the strategic partner portfolio, and expanding the ecosystem with new partners that contribute meaningful business.

  • Strategic Partner Management: Own and grow Tellent's most impactful DACH partner relationships, building long-term relationships and joint business plans focused on mutual growth.

  • Commercial Growth: Generate partner-sourced pipeline and revenue, improve opportunity quality and conversion, and ensure strong collaboration with Sales throughout the deal cycle.

  • Activation & Enablement: Ensure new and existing partners are effectively enabled on Tellent, our products, ICP and sales approach, and turn partnerships into active commercial relationships.

  • Market Development: Bring a strong point of view on the DACH market, identifying opportunities beyond the existing partner ecosystem and translating ideas into concrete execution.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with Sales, particularly the DACH Sales team, as well as Marketing and other Partnerships colleagues to improve deal execution, campaigns, enablement and pipeline quality.

  • Operational Excellence: Identify recurring friction in the partner GTM motion and contribute to improving playbooks, cadences, partner planning and ways of working across the wider Partnerships team.

What You Bring

  • Partnership Experience: Several years of experience in a partner, channel or business development role, with a proven track record of building and growing strategic partner relationships.

  • DACH Market Expertise: Strong understanding of the German market and ideally an established network of relevant DACH partners.

  • SaaS Experience: Experience in B2B SaaS, ideally within HR tech or an adjacent mid-market/SMB environment.

  • Commercial Skill: Strong understanding of pipeline generation, forecasting, partner planning and commercial performance, with experience in reseller and/or referral models.

  • Strategic Thinking: Able to assess a partner portfolio, identify where the biggest opportunities are, and make clear decisions about where to invest time and resources.

  • Execution: You don't just have ideas — you turn them into structured plans, actions and measurable results.

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset: You take ownership of the DACH partner business as if it were your own, proactively looking for opportunities and challenging existing assumptions.

  • Relationship Building: Strong at building trusted relationships while also being comfortable setting expectations, challenging partners and addressing underperformance.

  • Self-Management: Highly organised and able to manage a broad portfolio, prioritising time effectively across partners, Sales and new opportunities.

  • Communication: Professional fluency in German and English, comfortable engaging with senior stakeholders and operating across cross-functional teams.

  • Travel: Comfortable travelling regularly across Germany to build and maintain strong in-person partner relationships.

  • Diverse and international team environment

Tellent is a leading Talent Management Suite designed to empower HR & People teams across the entire employee journey. Our all-in-one platform combines an Applicant Tracking System (Tellent Recruitee), an intuitive HRIS (Tellent HR), and powerful Performance Management software (Tellent Grow).

jobs.title: Product Designer (Experimentation) (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Your mission

We're looking for a designer who decides with evidence. Most design roles stop at the handover. This one does not. You will design a part of the product, form a view about what should change, build the experiment that tests it, and read the results yourself. If you have ever shipped a redesign and never really found out whether it worked, this is the opposite of that.

You will sit inside one product delivery leadership team, working closely with the person accountable for that part of the business and with the engineers building it – not off to one side taking requests. And you will not be doing it alone: you join a group of Product Designers across the company who work the same way and hold each other's standards.

English is our working language. German matters here too: you will be designing flows that German-speaking neighbours read.

Concretely, you will:

  • Design experiences that fit how people already live. Our product mirrors real neighbourhood life. Your job is to design flows and screens that feel natural to someone standing on their doorstep with one hand on their phone, not to add features because we can.
  • Frame the real problem before solving it. Take a vague ask, find the actual question underneath it, and make it explainable. A well framed problem to solve is half the battle.
  • Run the experiment, and read it honestly. Design a testable change, get it instrumented properly, and analyse the outcome with our data team. That includes reporting the tests that did not work, which is most of them, and saying what you would do differently.
  • Talk to neighbours. Experiments tell you what happened, not what people needed. You will spend real time with the people who use this, because you cannot A/B test your way to understanding somebody.
  • Direct AI, and spend your judgment where it counts. AI produces a lot of our first-pass design. You will brief it, push back on it, and hold the quality bar, so your own hours go to the thinking a model cannot do. Polish goes where it changes behaviour, not onto every surface.
  • Argue for cutting things. Adding is easy. You will help decide what earns its place and what should be removed, and be willing to make the case for less.

Your profile

  • You practice design, and you are very comfortable with numbers. You might come from an analyst background and bring a love of design and design thinking, or vice versa.
  • You have technical know-how. You need to be able to construct the pipelines and dashboards yourself, use our experimentation platform, and our design system tooling.
  • You get your own numbers. Whether through SQL, AI-assisted querying, or both, you do not wait for someone else to pull data for you.
  • You have run experiments end to end. Hypothesis, design, instrumentation, analysis, decision. Not just handing a mockup to someone who tested it later.
  • You care about craft and are attentive to details. You can tell the difference between good enough and actually good and you design experiences people do not have to think about.
  • You use AI as a tool already or want to. This role allows you to have more control and impact through both design and analysis, but to do this well you'll need to leverage (and at times extend) our AI enablement stack.
  • You present your work clearly, defend your decisions when challenged, and are comfortable in front of a crowd.
  • Excellent English skills for working in our international team.

To apply, share a portfolio that shows your work by impact — at least one project walked through end to end: the hypothesis, what you designed, the result, and what you took from it. Show us how you used data to move your thinking forward, and where experimentation shaped what you built.

Nice to have

  • Experience with a marketplace, community, classifieds, or other network product.
  • Strong German, or the confidence to design in it with support.
  • Experience building or maintaining parts of a design system.
  • Comfortable writing SQL without AI assistance.

What we offer

  • Hybrid work model combining office and remote days
  • A meaningful job – we're creating a great product with real added value for the community
  • Work in a cheerful and experienced team that exchanges ideas and learns from each other
  • Insights into the entire work process of our social startup and the nebenan.de foundation

  • 30 days of vacation per year – we also offer the possibility of workation models and a sabbatical
  • A workplace in Berlin-Kreuzberg and regular events like yoga or Lunch & Learn sessions.

A Hybrid working model

If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a Account Director do at WPP Production? 


Our Account Director (AD) are knowledgeable and trusted Client leads.  Accountable for end-to-end project delivery, management of client and agency relationships, they lead a diverse and dynamic team to deliver. Responsible for operational discipline, delivery, resource optimisation and profitability management across Clients and projects. You are the key point person for the projects you are leading and are responsible for delivering on time, on specification and on budget. 

You possess problem-solving skills, have a passion for production, marketing and advertising and a desire to learn. Highly organised and accountable, you build trusting Client and team relationships, collaborate across multi-disciplined teams and draw on the expertise of Hogarth's resources and capabilities. You are ensure we execute flawlessly.

Communication

Collaboration

Process

Financials 

  • Demonstrate strong commercial abilities and business and financial acumen

  • Manage POs, financial reporting, tracking, billing against all project budgets
  • Manage financial aspects of assigned accounts including development of SOW and change orders, estimates, profitability analysis, and utilization, working with Finance where appropriate
  • Responsible for monthly billing and tracking of all production budgets
  • Ensure a thorough understanding of commercial arrangements, and SLA's across assigned accounts and ensure specific details are understood by the broader team
  • Protect margins
  • Proactively seek and identify new revenue opportunities across your clients

 

Requirements 

  • Project / Client management related experience within an interactive or integrated agency, with a good understanding of marketing and production implementation processes across all key channels, including digital, video, content, social etc
  • Good understanding of production and the creative development process, content production, technology, quality assurance testing and marketing methodologies

  • A professional, calm, approachable demeanour, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic highly matrixed agency environment

Why work here: 
At WPP Production, you'll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. We bring together world-class talent, cutting-edge studios, and advanced technology to solve some of the most complex creative and production challenges in the industry. You'll work in a collaborative, borderless environment where craft excellence is valued, innovation is encouraged, and AI and next-generation tools are used to amplify not replace human creativity. Chrono24 is the world’s leading online marketplace for luxury watches. Driven by a passion for timepieces and technology, we connect buyers and sellers from across the globe. Our goal is to maximise trust and transparency in the watch market.

About

Growth Operations is the engine room of Chrono24’s commercial execution - connecting Marketing, Supply, and VIP Sales with the analytical rigour and operational structure they need to make faster, better decisions. As Senior GTM Strategy Manager, you will be the analytical and operational backbone of the team, reporting to the Chief of Staff and working directly with Growth leadership - and, where relevant, the broader executive leadership - on the commercial questions that most directly determine our growth trajectory. We use AI tools as a matter of course, not an occasional shortcut. We expect this role to use them to compress the time between question, insight, and decision, and to help raise the standard across the team of what good, AI-enabled work looks like.


What you can expect

  • Own research, modelling, and problem-structuring on high-priority strategic questions (e.g. C2C strategy, new go-to-market motions), building scenario analyses rigorous enough to inform decisions and clear enough to present to executive leadership, using AI tools to move faster and think more rigorously.
  • Take cross-functional initiatives from framing through to delivery - including the messy middle of stakeholder coordination, dependency management, and keeping things moving; synthesise inputs into decision-ready recommendations and bring your own point of view rather than presenting options neutrally.
  • Design and maintain Growth’s internal KPI and performance reporting, working with the Data and BI teams to ensure the right metrics are tracked, defined consistently, and surfaced at the right cadence.
  • Identify performance trends, risks, and opportunities across our Marketplace and VIP go-to-market motions, and turn complex data into clear narratives for leadership discussions.
  • Own recurring analytical deliverables, including weekly and monthly performance summaries for the Growth leadership team.
  • Act as a thought partner on high-priority strategic initiatives such as US market acceleration and new go-to-market motions (e.g. CPO, certification, consignment).


What sets you apart

  • 5+ years in strategy consulting, investment banking, or a GTM / strategy / business operations role at a top-tier, high-growth technology company.
  • You’ve owned outcomes, not just workstreams: as comfortable driving a cross-functional initiative to completion as building the model that justified it.
  • Strong analytical skills: able to build a model, stress-test assumptions, and know when the numbers are telling you something real versus something convenient; you understand what they mean, not just what they say.
  • Fluent with AI tools: you use LLMs, research agents, and analytical co-pilots as a natural part of how you work, and you’re thoughtful about where they help and where human judgment still leads.
  • Commercial instinct and good judgment about where to invest effort; able to communicate findings clearly to senior stakeholders and make structure where there isn’t any.
  • Demonstrated interest in ecommerce and marketplaces; knowledge of luxury resale or the watch market is a plus. Fluent in English; German is a plus.


What we offer

  • A dynamic and international work environment.
  • The opportunity to contribute significantly to the expansion and success of our company.
  • Attractive compensation and development opportunities.
  • Benefit App: Discover our Benefit App, which offers you complete flexibility. Whether for your sports programme, as a daycare allowance or as a flexible mobility budget, with an additional monthly budget of €80 per person, you can use the benefits individually and design them according to your wishes!
  • Permanent contract: With a permanent contract, we offer you security and perspective in your career. We focus on long-term collaboration and your growth!
  • 30 days’ vacation: Enjoy a healthy work-life balance with 30 days’ vacation a year to relax and gain new inspiration. Your time is valuable - use it how you want!
  • Extra day off on December 24 and 31: Look forward to an extra day off on December 24 and 31 to enjoy the holidays to the full. This leaves more time for family, friends, and festive preparations!
  • Work from abroad 20 days/year: Take advantage of the opportunity to work from abroad for up to 20 days a year and discover new cultures.


Diversity@Chrono24: We believe in the power of diversity.

Diversity is our strength.
At Chrono24, we embrace diversity because we believe it enriches not only our corporate culture but also our success. Be yourself – and let’s achieve great things together!

jobs.description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

 

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

We’re looking for a Lead Business Analyst, Process & Automation to join our Capital and Payments team. Process & Automation is a small team working across the operations behind payments, lending, underwriting, risk, and billing. We find operational friction, diagnose root causes, and build the process, data, tooling, and automation solutions that fix it.

You will own projects end to end: find where a process is failing or create toil, prove it with data, design something better, coordinate the build with stakeholders, and stay with it until the receiving team owns it and the numbers have moved. AI is a default tool in how we work rather than a separate initiative.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role with full ownership of your projects.

 
 

What you’ll be doing:

  • Define: map end-to-end flows, trace handoffs, and understand how a process actually runs rather than how it is documented.

  • Diagnose: separate root causes from symptoms and quantify where time, money, and customers are being lost.

  • Design: turn what you find into clear requirements, better flows, and delivery plans with measurable success criteria, then build or coordinate the automation, tooling, data, and controls they depend on.

  • Instrument: lead testing and launch readiness, track impact against agreed measures, drive adoption, and hand ownership back to the team that owns the outcome.

  • Establish how we use AI agents in operations: identify where they create real leverage, then design, test, and deploy them for bounded, multi-step workflows, including the evaluation methods that prove they work.

  • Partner with teams outside operations whose work affects these outcomes, and turn operational findings into business cases that help Product and Technology prioritize longer-term solutions.

 
 

What you need to bring:

We're looking for a candidate who has experience with the following:

  • 7+ years in business analysis, process improvement, operations, implementation, or product operations.

  • A track record leading complex cross-functional projects from problem definition through implementation and ongoing measurement.

  • Strong analytical skills - you use data, queries, and dashboards to validate problems and prove outcomes, not only to report on them.

  • Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business needs into clear requirements, process designs, and delivery plans.

  • Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation, written communication, and presentation skills, with a track record of driving alignment and outcomes across teams you do not manage.

 
 

Even better if you have, but not necessary:

  • Financial services, fintech, payments, lending, or insurance - or another complex, regulated operating environment.

  • Commerce, e-commerce, point-of-sale, or marketplace experience.

  • Hands-on experience with workflow, case-management, or process-automation platforms.

  • SQL, business-intelligence tools, or data modelling.

  • Experience evaluating or deploying AI-enabled solutions for operational use cases.

  • Experience driving adoption and effectiveness after launch, not just delivery.

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

Be a changemaker

 
 

You’ll enjoy:

  • A flexible work environment that empowers you to do your best work

  • A culture that celebrates performance

  • The chance to make an impact in a team that’s big enough for career growth, but lean enough to make your voice heard

  • Career-defining opportunities

Plus benefits designed to keep you happy, healthy and fulfilled.

  • Flexible paid time off and remote work policies

  • Equity options, because this is your company too

  • Contributions to your pension plan. Your future matters

  • Training opportunities to grow your skills and career

  • Health and wellness credit so you feel your best

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Interest groups, employee led networks, social committees to sponsored sports teams

  • Computer purchase program to get your personal Macbook

  • Enhanced parental leave to support growing families

  • Etc…

 

Fuel your growth. Find your people.

At Lightspeed, your growth is our priority. We invest in you with continuous learning opportunities, global mobility and benefits designed to support you—all within a driven, diverse and inclusive team that’s passionate about empowering our communities

Please note that we ask applicants to disclose any criminal convictions, and we conduct criminal record checks as part of our hiring process for this role.
