jobs.description:
About the team

OpenAI’s Forward Deployed Engineering team partners with customers to turn research breakthroughs into production systems. We operate at the intersection of customer delivery and core platform development.

About the role

Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) lead complex end-to-end deployments of frontier models in production alongside our most strategic customers. You will own discovery, technical scoping, system design, build, and production rollout, partnering directly with customer engineering and domain teams.

You will measure success through production adoption, measurable workflow impact, and eval-driven feedback that changes product and model roadmaps. You’ll work closely with our Product, Research, Partnerships, GRC, Security, and GTM teams.

This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. Travel up to 50% is required.

In this role you will

  • Own technical delivery across multiple deployments from first prototype to stable production

  • Build full-stack systems that deliver customer value and sharpen how we learn

  • Embed closely with customer teams, understand their needs, and guide adoption of what you build

  • Scope work, sequence delivery, and remove blockers early

  • Make trade-offs between scope, speed, and quality; adjust plans to protect delivery

  • Contribute directly in the code when progress or clarity depends on it

  • Codify working patterns into tools, playbooks, or building blocks that others can use

  • Share field feedback that helps Research and Product understand where the models succeed and where they can improve

  • Keep teams moving through clarity and follow-through

You might thrive in this role if you

  • Bring 6+ years of engineering or technical deployment experience that includes customer-facing work

  • Professional fluency in Spanish and English is required, as this role supports Spanish-speaking customers

  • Have scoped and delivered complex systems in fast-moving or ambiguous environments

  • Write and review production-grade code across frontend and backend using Python, JavaScript, or comparable stacks

  • Have built or deployed systems powered by LLMs or generative models and understand how model behaviour affects product experience

  • Simplify complexity and make fast, sound decisions under pressure

  • Communicate clearly with engineers, product teams, and customer stakeholders

  • Spot risks early and adjust without slowing down

  • Model calm and judgment when the stakes are high

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Head of Financial Systems, you will shape the future of Mistral’s Finance technology ecosystem.

The role exists to build a modern data, systems and AI-driven finance department that bridges finance, data, and business operations to drive financial performance and strategic decision-making.

You’ll collaborate closely with our CFO, our internal Applied AI resources, and teams like, HR, IT, Legal, and Security to assess current systems, identify gaps, and design a target architecture that supports Mistral’s growth.

Your impact will be felt across the organization, from improving profitability to automating accounting and ensuring reliable financial outputs.

 
 

What You Will Do

  • Lead the assessment of Mistral’s current Finance technology landscape, including tools, processes, data flows and pain points.

  • Define and prioritize business, functional, and technical requirements for Finance systems in collaboration with stakeholders.

  • Design a target Finance tech architecture, outlining system roles, integrations, and data flows and architectures

  • Develop a data governance framework, including ownership, quality controls, and maintenance processes.

  • Create and execute a prioritized plan to clean up and rationalize Finance datasets and execute it

  • Deliver a clear recommendation on the future Finance tech setup, including costs, risks, and a transition roadmap.

  • Ensure Finance data is migration-ready by addressing quality issues and defining ownership.

 
 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong project management skills, from defining vision, strategy, and roadmaps, to stelar execution

  • Engineering academic background, ideally from a tier-1 engineering school

  • Deep data architecture knowledge, including mastery of data sources, pipelines, storage, transformation, and metadata management, with hands-on experience designing and implementing architectures (e.g., APIs, workflows, BigQuery, DBT).

  • GenAI power user with Vibe coding skills, automation expertise, and experience building scalable, impactful products in a professional context. Basic coding skills and software development experience are a strong plus.

  • Experience in Finance technology assessment, system selection, and knowledge of tools such as SAP S4H, Kyriba, Lago, Payflows, etc

  • Solid financial knowledge, including experience working alongside finance teams, understanding FP&A, accounting, cash management, and procurement, and a strong interest in driving value through process automation and efficiency.

  • Builder and scaler with experience structuring IT systems (preferably in finance), building and scaling IT teams or departments from the ground up, and operating in multicountry environments.

  • Proven ability to build tools and processes from scratch to support company growth.

  • Strong analytical skills to evaluate data quality, consistency, and relevance.

  • Proficiency in prioritization and the use of performance metrics to drive impact.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

tags: Ingénierie et services de la santé
jobs.description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École.

Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Quand la technologie rencontre la médecine, ça donne… le Centre Ingénierie Santé (CIS) !

Des dispositifs médicaux innovants (biomécanique, biomatériaux, nanoparticules) aux jumeaux numériques du patient et de l’hôpital, le CIS développe des solutions sur mesure pour répondre aux enjeux actuels de la santé.

🧠 Modélisation, simulation, intelligence collective : nos enseignants-chercheurs travaillent main dans la main avec médecins, industriels et institutions.

💙 Une seule ambition : améliorer le soin et la vie des personnes grâce à la science.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que post-doctorant(e), vous êtes au cœur des missions de recherche et d’innovation du Centre Ingénierie et Santé. Vous rejoignez l’équipe i4S pour développer les fondements scientifiques d’une nouvelle génération de jumeaux numériques populationnels (JNP) en santé, en lien étroit avec la société Dali.

Le Centre Ingénierie et Santé développe des recherches à l’interface entre ingénierie, mathématiques, informatique et santé. Ses travaux associent modélisation, simulation, intelligence artificielle et sciences des données pour répondre à des problématiques cliniques, organisationnelles et populationnelles en collaboration avec des acteurs académiques, hospitaliers et industriels.

Dali (Decision Aid · Live Innovation) est un bureau d’études innovant spécialisé dans la modélisation, la simulation et l’intelligence artificielle appliquées au système de santé. Son ambition est de transformer le système de soins grâce à une ingénierie de pointe basée sur des données : création de jumeaux numériques, modélisation prédictive, optimisation de parcours patients, modélisation de services hospitaliers et amélioration des performances des organisations de santé. Dali a été co-créée début 2025 par Martin PRODEL (PhD, 12 ans d’expérience en données de santé, ex-Heva) et Vincent Augusto (PhD, HDR, Pr, 20 d’expérience en ingénierie de la santé et recherche, Mines Saint-Etienne). 

Objectif stratégique : préparer les briques scientifiques des JNP à horizon 3 à 5 ans, au-delà des premiers démonstrateurs industriels déjà engagés.

 

Le post-doctorat doit permettre de lever des verrous en modélisation dynamique de cohortes, génération de patients virtuels, apprentissage des transitions et simulation de scénarios contrefactuels.

 

Vos missions principales :

  • Vous concevez et formalisez des modèles mathématiques et stochastiques de trajectoires de patients : chaînes de Markov, modèles multi-états, modèles d’état, processus de décision markoviens, simulation Monte-Carlo et approches hybrides.

  • Vous développez en Python des prototypes de JNP capables d’apprendre leurs paramètres à partir de données réelles, de générer des trajectoires virtuelles et de tester des scénarios thérapeutiques ou de prise en charge.

  • Vous proposez des méthodes de calibration, d’estimation, d’optimisation, de quantification de l’incertitude et de validation des modèles ; vous comparez les approches sur des cas d’usage issus de cohortes, registres ou données de vie réelle.

  • Vous contribuez à la valorisation scientifique des travaux (publications, conférences, logiciels), à la formalisation des briques transférables vers DALI et vous rendez compte de l’avancement au responsable scientifique du projet.

 

Votre capacité à passer d’un problème scientifique à un modèle formel puis à une implémentation robuste sera essentielle. Le poste demande un goût prononcé pour les mathématiques appliquées, l’algorithmique, la programmation scientifique et la recherche interdisciplinaire.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes impérativement titulaire d’un :

  • Doctorat (Bac + 8) en mathématiques appliquées, informatique, automatique, recherche opérationnelle, génie industriel, data science quantitative ou domaine proche.

Profil scientifique recherché :

  • Solide formation en probabilités, statistiques, processus stochastiques, optimisation, modélisation et simulation, et/ou systèmes dynamiques.

  • Appétence pour le domaine de la santé.

Compétences attendues :

  • Maîtrise avancée de Python scientifique (NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn ou équivalents) et bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel, versionnement et reproductibilité.

  • Expérience significative d’au moins une famille de modèles dynamiques : Markov / MDP, modèles multi-états, Monte-Carlo, équations différentielles, modèles d’état ou simulation multi-agents / à événements discrets.

  • Capacité à articuler modèles mathématiques et données : estimation de paramètres, calibration, analyse de sensibilité, validation, quantification de l’incertitude.

  • Maîtrise de l’anglais scientifique écrit et oral (niveau B2 minimum, C1 apprécié) ; capacité à rédiger des articles et à présenter des travaux dans un contexte international.

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

  • Expérience sur données longitudinales, données de santé, cohortes, essais cliniques ou données de vie réelle.

  • Connaissance d’un environnement de simulation (AnyLogic, SimPy, MATLAB/Simulink ou équivalent) et/ou d’un langage compilé (C++, Java).

  • Expérience de publication dans des revues ou conférences en modélisation, simulation, intelligence artificielle, recherche opérationnelle ou santé numérique.

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

  • Have direct hands-on experience in Salesforce and/or Outreach (not just awareness or admin-level use)

  • Have full working proficiency in French and at least an advanced level in English.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer - PLC / Plant Control (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

METYCLE - where innovation meets sustainability

We are building the B2B online platform to accelerate the global circular flow of secondary metals. By connecting buyers and sellers of scrap metal globally, we enable efficient trade of secondary metals and drive the seamless flow of recycling material, essential for reducing CO2 emissions by up to 95% compared to primary metal production.

And we take it further! We are pioneering an innovative Smart Sorting Facility that leverages AI, machine learning, and robotics to transform how scrap metal is processed, enhance material quality, improve traceability, and drive the recycling industry into the digital era.

Join us at the early stage in bringing the $610 billion scrap metal trading industry into the 21st century and in shaping the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions.


READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

If you are passionate about industrial automation, solving complex technical challenges, and building something from the ground up, join our team as an Industrial Automation Engineer.

The machinery is the easy part to buy. The control system that turns it into a plant - and the standards, documentation, and data that keep it running - is what we are hiring you to own.

We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to take ownership of our plant’s control systems from design through commissioning and into stable production. You bring deep hands-on experience in programming and commissioning industrial control systems and are comfortable taking responsibility for the PLC, safety systems, HMI, industrial networking, and interfaces between multiple machine suppliers.

Beyond programming, you understand what it takes to make a plant genuinely reliable in production and have the technical confidence to hold suppliers to high professional standards. Join our international team, help build innovative solutions for scrap metal processing, and contribute to a more sustainable future.


YOUR MISSION

  • PLC & Plant Control: Design, write, and own the PLC program using Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500, including control logic, sequencing, fault handling, and HMI
  • Commissioning & Production: Take the plant from design through commissioning to a stable, running line, owning the full journey through FAT/SAT and the hands-on work required to make the plant genuinely reliable
  • Plant Availability: Design stop and interlock behaviour to minimise unnecessary downtime — allowing unaffected parts of the plant to keep running when it is safe to do so. Plant availability is a direct business outcome here, and you will directly influence it
  • Machine Safety: Implement the machine-safety control concept on a fail-safe F-CPU with F-I/O, including the hardwired e-stop loop, PLC-enforced zone isolation that cannot be overridden, guard interlocks, and controlled, sequenced shutdown
  • Safety & Compliance: Be our in-house technical counterpart on EN ISO 13849 performance-level determination and the CE file, working with external assessors while retaining ownership of the technical approach and decisions
  • Machine Integration: Integrate control systems from several different machine suppliers into one coherent line, so that a single stop is genuinely a single stop across the whole plant
  • Supplier Management: Hold machine builders and panel builders to specification, including unlocked code, complete documentation, and standards compliance
  • OT / IT & Industrial IoT: Get plant data out over OPC UA / MQTT / Modbus TCP into our own systems, so stoppage reasons, energy use, and throughput become actionable data. Work closely with our Industrial IoT team, who own the edge and data side of that boundary


YOUR PROFILE

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience programming and commissioning industrial control systems, with a track record of bringing production equipment or complete lines into stable operation
  • Deep Siemens TIA Portal / S7-1200 & S7-1500 experience, with strong skills in SCL, LAD/FBD, HMI/SCADA, industrial networking (PROFINET, PROFIBUS, Modbus TCP), drives/VFDs, and fault-finding
  • Strong machine safety competence, including F-CPU / Safety Integrated and EN ISO 13849, with the ability to explain and defend performance-level determinations
  • Comfortable reading electrical schematics and troubleshooting cabinets, hardware, signals, wiring, and control behaviour directly on the shop floor. You have brought at least one production line from commissioning into stable production; maintenance-only experience is not sufficient
  • Experience working with machine and panel builders, with the confidence to hold suppliers accountable for code quality, documentation, standards compliance, and professional delivery
  • Experience with brownfield projects and legacy migration (STEP 7 Classic → TIA); experience in bulk material handling, recycling, sorting, or minerals processing is a plus
  • Experience with PLC version control, simulation / digital twins, or structured automation approaches is desirable. Additional IT/OT skills such as Python, C#/TIA Openness, SQL, Linux, Docker, MES/IIoT, OT network segmentation, or IEC 62443 are a plus
  • Independent, structured, and hands-on, with a strong sense of ownership. You challenge assumptions, hold suppliers to a high standard, and document what you build
  • Fluent in English; German and/or Dutch is a plus. Ideally based in or near Cologne or the Benelux/border region, with valid EU work authorisation and the willingness to travel to our Smart Sorting Facility in Belgium, Maasmechelen


WHY JOIN US?

  • You will have the opportunity to challenge the status quo and work on an innovative venture with a significant impact
  • You will be able to take ownership and shape the future of metal recycling and green energy solutions at an early stage
  • We offer a competitive salary including virtual company shares
  • We offer an environment with flat hierarchies and a steep learning curve with exciting growth opportunities
  • You will benefit from flexible working hours and the opportunity to work remotely or from a shared office location
  • We promote an inclusive, diverse and supportive work environment

About us | LinkedIn

jobs.description:
Location: Remote in Europe

 

About Nivoda 🚀

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

Our platform gives businesses of all sizes, from independent jewellers to major retail chains access to the world's best diamond and gemstone inventory, without the traditional barriers of capital, geography, or information asymmetry.

 

Our Mission 🎯

Diamond and gemstone trading has long been plagued by inefficiency, opacity, and exclusivity. Nivoda was built to change that - to democratise access and empower every business, regardless of size or location, to buy and sell with confidence. Independent jewellers are at the heart of this mission. They deserve the same access to quality, pricing, and selection as the biggest players in the industry. That's exactly what we give them.

 

About the Role 🤔

Conversion is one of the three chokepoints in our revenue organisation. Customers arrive, take the demo, go through KYC, and too many stall before the first purchase, or buy once and never come back. The second purchase is where the product becomes sticky, and getting a merchant there is the hardest 60 days of their life with us.

Fixing that takes two things, and this role owns both. Reps who know the product, the pricing and the playbook cold. And a conversion funnel that is measured, scored and coached rather than hoped for.

 

Function one: enablement

Training and standards

  • Make sure every rep is up to spec and trained, and keep them there.

  • Own the theoretical onboarding of every new rep, SDR, AE and AM alike: what Nivoda sells, to whom, at what price, and how.

  • Set what "up to spec" means for each role and hold the bar.

Documentation and materials

  • Own the product material for every line of business: how it works, who it is for, pricing, take rate and best practice.

  • Keep it current. A rep should never be the last person to find out something changed.

The channel to marketing

  • Act as the link between marketing and the front line. Every campaign is known to the reps in advance, socialised at the all-hands before it lands, not discovered from a customer.

The channel to product

  • Translate the product roadmap into enablement. You do not decide the roadmap. You turn it into what to sell, to whom, and when.

  • When something ships, the reps already know what it is and how to position it.

Function two: conversion

Conversion rests on two things, and this role owns both: the call, and the KYC. A brilliant call that dies in KYC converts nothing, and a clean KYC on a badly run call never gets there.

Call scoring

  • Build the scoring rubrics with the team managers, so the standard is one both sides recognise.

  • Run transcript review and scoring at volume, using Claude to do it.

  • Send the reports out every week, to everyone.

  • Run a weekly leaderboard: the best calls, the scores, winners and losers, visible to the team.

  • Build a personalised coaching plan for every rep, written down and tracked, not delivered verbally and forgotten.

  • Coach in two directions: with the managers so they can coach their own people, and directly with reps where that is faster.

KYC

  • Own the insight generation of what is working and not on the process

  • Hold the accountability of the KYC SLAs, and call it out when they slip.

  • Map the blockers and the escalation paths, and push the fix at the cause rather than the symptom, across sales, product and marketing as needed.

  • Make sure the KYC operators know the rules, and that the rules are written.

  • Train and enable both sides of it: the reps and the operations team.

How we will measure it 💻

  • Conversion through to second purchase at 75% of each new cohort.

  • KYC above 60%, in every geography, not just on the average.

  • Rubric and call scores in place and reported weekly.

  • 80% compliance against the rubric, reached by your fourth month in the role.

What do we need from you? 💪

  • Experience in sales enablement, revenue operations or frontline sales coaching in a transactional, high-volume environment.

  • You have scored calls at volume and can show what changed as a result. Gong or equivalent.

  • You are fluent with AI tooling and would run transcript review and scoring through Claude rather than by hand.

  • You have built onboarding for reps from scratch, not just delivered someone else's deck.

  • You can coach a manager, not just a rep. You are comfortable telling a senior person their team's calls are not good enough, and then showing them how to fix it.

  • You write clearly. A large part of the value here is documentation other people can pick up and use.

  • You work across Product, Marketing and Finance without authority over any of them.

  • Hands-on. This is not a strategy seat. You will be on calls, in the CRM and in the material every week.

Nice to have ✨

  • Experience with onboarding or activation motions rather than pure new business.

  • Diamonds, jewellery, or another supply-driven marketplace.

  • A second language relevant to EMEA or North America.

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

The Opportunity

The Portfolio Lead curates a world-class UK apprenticeship product set focused on AI upskilling. Working as one of two dedicated leads within our AI vertical, you are an AI-literate strategist who isn’t shy about your passion for how generative AI, agentic workshops and complex AI transformative initiatives are reshaping the workforce. You have a deep understanding of the AI tooling market, both now and how it will continue to evolve.

Practically, you will own the roadmap and key performance metrics for a set of products, proactively scoping new UK releases to grow bookings and influencing cross-organisational decisions on how to maintain and improve programme retention and quality as we scale. Given the pace of change in the wider policy sector, you will serve as an important internal voice on how we can respond to and influence the shape of new policy innovations such as apprenticeship units.

You are the technical point of contact for GTM discovery, often supporting complex deal structures or tooling partnership meetings to maximise alignment between our data products and client needs. You also deeply understand what effective, high-impact learning looks like in a technical data context and will support our Admissions, Delivery, Learning and Technology/Product teams to evolve their processes as we launch new products or improve our existing offerings. As we release synchronous and blended learning models, you will be vital in quality-assuring our products and supporting other members of the Learning team (such as Senior Programme Designers and Technical Learning Designers) to make the right choices to maximise learner engagement.

What You’ll Do

Portfolio Strategy

  • AI Product Roadmap: Own the development and iteration of a sub set of our AI product offerings by analysing data (both internal and external) to improve net new bookings, customer retention and learner retention

  • Market Alignment: Validate our assumptions and competitor analysis in the market in partnership with Product Marketing, shaping how we communicate technical value and competitor positioning

  • Horizon Scanning: Stay ahead of the curve on data and tooling trends to identify new skills development pain points and opportunities

  • Investment Validation: Support GTM, Finance and our Delivery teams to scope custom data offerings, balancing market potential against the technical investment required

  • Policy Influence: Support our Policy team to craft compelling responses to consultation requests and consider proactive initiatives to actively shape apprenticeship policy for your area

Product Development, Launch & Iteration

  • Learning Squad Management and Prioritisation: work collaboratively with stakeholders across the business to create compliant apprenticeship curricula which meet learner and client needs. Use data and insights (qualitative and quantitative) to identify and prioritise opportunities for growth and improvement, including managing the backlog and prioritisation of improvements for wider Learning team members and teams external to Learning

  • Organisational enablement and readiness: support partners in Delivery, Admissions and Product to assess and enable the readiness of our systems and people to deliver a high quality learning experience

  • Proactive Risk Mitigation: Identify and escalate risks to all levels in the organisation, including C Suite, to ensure products remain on track to hit quality benchmarks.

  • Agile Feedback Integration: Establish and lead rigorous feedback loops for your products. You won't just "collect" feedback; you will find effective ways to synthesise what you are hearing from different sources including our own internal delivery teams, learners and clients

  • Expert Credibility: Serve as the internal and external "voice of the data practitioner," building trust with technical leaders and stakeholders at all levels

What You’ll Bring

  • AI Domain Expertise: You bring a sophisticated background in AI upskilling, fueled by a network of experts that ensures you’re always ahead of the next big shift. You understand the infrastructure and tools needed to support modern AI - generative, agentic and beyond

  • Product or Curriculum Launch Experience: Proven experience working with a broad cross functional group of stakeholders to launch learning products and their ongoing improvements

  • Confident Written and Oral Communication at all levels: You switch with ease from talking about the technical specifications of a new learning lab environment, to effectively raising a risk with the SLT on product performance, to convincing a CIO on the ROI your products bring to his business metrics. You actively enjoy thinking about how to influence these different stakeholders

  • Ability to distinguish between signal and noise: You know how to make stakeholders feel heard whilst holding the line on what is right to prioritise and why. You effectively balance the need to improve learner experience with the practical realities of working with constrained resources

  • A strong vision for applied learning: you strongly believe in the power of apprenticeship and applied learning models to supercharge the acquisition of data skills and you bring vision and expertise both internally and externally to how to do this effectively

  • AI enabled practices: you have experience building and using AI workflows to automate research, development and reporting tasks. You are excited about embracing AI to help you spend time on the tasks which most need your expertise

Preferred Skills and Qualifications

  • AI Practitioner: you have significant technical proficiency in AI automation tooling and can speak from lived experience in designing learning for these tools

  • Instructional Literacy: Experience with cohort-based or online content creation, specifically within technical or professional training

Regulatory Knowledge: Experience working within regulated structures (e.g., UK Apprenticeship Levy) is a significant plus.

Benefits

  • Health & Wellness- private medical Insurance with Bupa, a medical cashback scheme, life insurance, gym membership & wellness resources through Wellhub and access to Spill - all in one mental health support

Hybrid, based in our London, Bath or Edinburgh office. We are flexible but would like you to be in the office at least once per week.

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

We’re looking for an engineering manager to lead one of our product engineering squads, reporting to an engineering director. As Seccl grows and our platform supports more customer firms and investors, you’ll help your squad deliver the scalable platform capability we need for what comes next.

You’ll build a strong, psychologically safe engineering team where people feel trusted, supported and able to do their best work. You’ll coach and develop engineers, create clarity and help the team maintain high standards while delivering valuable outcomes.

Working closely with your product manager, engineering leaders and teams across Seccl, you’ll help define priorities and keep the squad focused on the right outcomes. You’ll balance delivery pace with engineering quality, security, operational resilience and long-term maintainability.

This role brings together people leadership, delivery and engineering accountability. You’ll stay close enough to the technology to guide and challenge decisions, while giving engineers the ownership and support they need to develop effective solutions.

What you’ll own

  • Building, leading and developing an inclusive, high-performing engineering squad

  • Creating an environment of trust, psychological safety, continual learning and constructive challenge

  • Owning the delivery health of your squad, from priorities and planning through to production readiness, reliability and ongoing maintainability

  • Partnering with product managers to align the squad’s work with customer, commercial, regulatory and platform priorities

  • Guiding technical decisions and helping the team build solutions that are scalable, secure, resilient and well integrated with the wider platform

  • Using metrics, feedback and team insight to improve delivery predictability, system reliability and team effectiveness

  • Recruiting and onboarding engineers while contributing to shared engineering practices and collaboration across Seccl

This role’s for you if...

  • You’re an experienced engineering manager who has led teams working within complex product or technology domains

  • You have a strong track record of hiring, onboarding, coaching and developing engineers

  • You can balance people leadership with delivery accountability and remain close enough to the technology to offer meaningful guidance

  • You have experience with a modern JavaScript and cloud-based technology stack. Our stack includes Node.js, JavaScript and TypeScript, MongoDB, AWS, Lambda and Serverless Framework

  • You communicate clearly and can work effectively with product managers, engineering leaders and senior stakeholders

  • You have recent, practical experience with AI-assisted engineering tools and can help teams use them responsibly to improve delivery, quality and developer effectiveness

  • You care about building secure, scalable and resilient systems. Experience in financial services, fintech, investment platforms or another regulated environment would be valuable

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You’re looking for a purely people-management role. You’ll need enough technical credibility to guide decisions and challenge constructively

  • You want to be the primary technical decision-maker. You’ll create the environment for engineers to own solutions and grow their capability

  • You need priorities to remain fixed. You’ll be leading delivery in a fast-moving environment where plans and business needs can change

  • You prioritise speed at the expense of quality. Delivery pace matters, alongside security, resilience and long-term maintainability

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

  • 💰 £95,000 to £110,000 depending on experience, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

  • 🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and paid dependant leave

  • 💙 Two volunteering days each year

  • 🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

  • 🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

  • 🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

  • 🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

  • 👪 Enhanced parental leave

  • 💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

  • 📖 £750 annual learning budget

  • 🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

  • 🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

  • 🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

  • 🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

  • Initial conversation: a chat with someone from our Talent team about your experience, what you’re looking for and the role

  • System design interview: a 60-minute technical conversation exploring how you approach architecture, trade-offs and complex engineering decisions

  • Leadership interview: a 45-minute conversation focused on people leadership, delivery and cross-functional collaboration

  • Bar raiser: a 45-minute conversation with colleagues from outside the immediate team, focused on our operating principles and how you approach your work

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

Everyone’s welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

Our culture:

Never settle – We think of ourselves as ‘embedded hero-makers’ for our customers. We put them first, and if we say we’ll do something, we’ll move heaven and earth to do it. We think boldly and embrace change.

Take ownership - We think rigorously and deeply about a problem, but then charge at it, acting with and urgency and speed that sets us apart. But we never lose sight of quality or long-term scalability.

Be generous & candid - We encourage our people – and our customers – to challenge us and never shy away from tough conversations. We have a flat and inclusive culture where everyone can be themselves – and speak up.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Our engineering ways of working:

  • Our Product and Engineering organisation is structured into four tribes: Custody, Accounts, Experience, and Cloud & Security. Each tribe contains multiple autonomous squads, with clear full ownership over specific product domains.

  • The squads are intentionally small and cross-functional, typically made up of an Engineering Manager, Product Manager, and 3–5 engineers with complementary skills aligned to the domain they own.

  • We operate in a build-and-run model, with teams responsible for the full software lifecycle, from architecture and delivery through to operational support and incident management.

  • Our core platform is built on AWS serverless technologies including Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, S3, and ECS. We primarily develop in TypeScript and Node.js, with MongoDB as our primary document database. We also have a small number of C# services and are continuing to evolve our platform architecture, including expanding our use of ECS Fargate.

  • Infrastructure is managed through a combination of Terraform and Serverless Framework. We use GitHub Actions for CI/CD and incident.io to support our incident management processes and operational workflows.

  • We care deeply about engineering quality, pragmatic architecture, and continuous improvement. If you’d like to go deeper, we’re happy to share more about our engineering practices and technology radar during the interview process.

The role

As an engineer at Seccl you will design, build and operate reliable and scalable, testable and maintainable software solutions, building new functionalities and products using Typescript and Node.js. You play a key role in our software development and have a hands-on approach throughout the development process supporting resilient financial workflow systems and regulated investment operations. As a senior member of the team, you are the ‘go-to’ person for queries.

On a typical day you will…

  • Work collaboratively in a domain aligned cross-functional squad made up of engineers and product along with colleagues from customer-facing and operations teams

  • Design, implement and operate your services within your domain

  • Be accountable for the SLAs of your products and iterative improvements

  • Maintain and extend documentation for your services

  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement and technical excellence while understanding when “good enough for now” is appropriate

  • Provide guidance and mentorship for other engineers

  • Communicate with non-technical colleagues to answer queries about the Seccl system

What you need…

  • To own your services from design to operation. We operate a build-and-run model where engineers have autonomy but full accountability.

  • We care deeply about correctness, resilience and operational excellence because our systems underpin real customer investments.

  • Engineers are not passengers in their products but champions. Drive improvements and features while collaborating openly with product, operations and engineering colleagues, challenging ideas constructively and focusing on delivering the best outcomes for customers.

  • Have a strong ability to understand business and customer problems and turn them into efficient, scalable solutions. Be curious about how investment and custody products operate, and pragmatic in balancing customer value, operational correctness, engineering quality and long-term scalability.

  • Experience building financial systems with multi-region, multi-currency or trading-related complexity would be advantageous.

  • Experience in a strongly/statically typed language.

  • Have a strong understanding of designing, building, and running high-quality, standards-compliant workflow APIs, with a focus on testing, observability, and performance.

  • Have worked with a cloud provider (AWS/Azure/GCP). We use AWS.

  • Have worked with distributed systems and are comfortable debugging through tracing and observability.

  • Willing to be on-call for your services.

Core technical skills you must have:

  • Strong commercial experience with Node.js, specifically TypeScript

  • Experience with Amazon Web Services

  • Experience with Serverless products

  • Experience with document databases, ideally MongoDB

  • Experience mentoring engineers

  • Experience leading technical delivery in a build-and-run engineering model

  • Experience in a structured on-call process and incident management

  • Experience working in regulated industries, ideally financial services or FinTech.

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You rely on a lot of top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership of your role, and you’ll be expected to shape your own progression, bring forward ideas, and spot opportunities to improve

  • You’re not comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet

  • You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen

  • You don’t like change. You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

What’s in it for you…

We offer a generous mix of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including:

Base salary based on experience and skills demonstrated during our assessment phase

🌴 27 days holiday + bank holidays (some can be flexible) + day off on your birthday + three days (full time) per year for Dependant leave

💙 Two volunteering days per year

🌎 Option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

🌻 Health and wellbeing initiatives including free therapy via Wellness Cloud, mental health support via Headspace

🌱 Strong financial wellbeing focus including access to Octopus Money, Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing offering via Octopus Legacy

🎁 Perkbox – Flexi-points giving you a range of discounts and perks including free weekly coffee, gym and retail discounts

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way thing, and we want you to have the time and opportunity to get to know us, as much as we are getting to know you. Our interviews are conversational, so come with questions and be curious. In general, you can expect the interview process to look a bit like this:

  • Technical loop - 2.45h virtual technical assessment with 3 core components - system design, bar raiser round and TypeScript code review with breaks between the stages. You will receive preparation materials for the round and more information on how to prepare.

About the job

Lead the design, development, and adoption of AI systems within a strategic business domain.

You will combine deep AI engineering expertise with product and business understanding to identify high-impact opportunities, define roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes.

As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal

Why Now, Why Mirakl

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Principal AI Engineer to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into reliable, scalable, and measurable products used by leading enterprises worldwide.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.


What You'll Do

1. Own Tech Strategy for Your Domain

  • Define the Tech vision and own the agent product roadmap for your domain

2. Lead AI System Development

  • Design and build production-grade AI systems
  • Drive architecture decisions
  • Ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability

3. Drive Adoption & Business Impact

  • Work closely with end users
  • Measure adoption and outcomes
  • Accelerate AI transformation across your domain

4. Establish Technical Excellence

  • Promote best practices for evaluation, testing, guardrails, and observability
  • Review designs and mentor engineers
  • Raise the quality bar across initiatives

5. Grow AI Capability

  • Mentor AI Engineers and Agent Builders
  • Share knowledge and reusable components

jobs.title: Principal Thermo-Mechanical Engineer- Paris/Grenoble
jobs.description:
About Us

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value.

As trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics, you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

  • Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value.

  • Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

  • Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

  • Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial simulation software (Asys, Abaqus, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermo-mechanical simulations— either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

  • Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

  • Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

  • Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

  • Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

  • Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

  • Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with thermal solutions management and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

  • Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

  • Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

  • Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

  • Not just use AI; be part of a team actively redefining how next-generation silicon and hardware are architected.

  • Work at the absolute convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise

  • Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.Ingénieur / Ingénieure principal/e en thermomécanique (H/F) — Paris/Grenoble

    À propos de Vinci

    Vinci développe une IA fondée sur la physique (Physics AI) pour la conception de systèmes hardware. Notre plateforme donne aux équipes de conception et de simulation des prédictions physiques précises, obtenues en une fraction du temps d'une simulation classique, et qui s'intègrent à leurs outils existants.

    C'est la première solution à offrir à la fois la rigueur de la simulation traditionnelle et la vitesse de l'IA. Elle transforme la façon dont les semi-conducteurs les plus avancés au monde sont conçus, vérifiés, fabriqués, mis sur le marché et intégrés dans des systèmes complexes.

    Présentation du poste

    En tant que membre clé de notre équipe européenne de Forward Deployment, vous jouerez un rôle déterminant dans l'adoption de la plateforme Vinci par les principales organisations d'ingénierie de la région. Dans ce rôle stratégique, vous constituerez, accompagnerez et dirigerez une équipe performante de spécialistes en ingénierie thermique, chargée d'accompagner nos clients et prospects et de démontrer concrètement la valeur de notre logiciel.

    En tant que référent technique de confiance auprès de nos clients, vous et votre équipe mettrez à profit votre expertise approfondie en simulation pour aider nos clients industriels à valider et optimiser des conceptions complexes dans des conditions représentatives de leurs applications réelles. À travers ces collaborations, vous démontrerez comment la plateforme Vinci permet d'améliorer les performances thermiques et la fiabilité des produits, tout en accélérant les cycles de conception et la mise sur le marché.

    Grâce à votre solide maîtrise de la mécanique des milieux continus, vous guiderez l'analyse de phénomènes physiques complexes : comportements linéaires, non-linéarités géométriques et matérielles, et interactions de contact. Votre équipe aidera les clients à évaluer des paramètres critiques tels que le warpage, l'évolution des contraintes, le cyclage thermique et la fiabilité, sur des composants semi-conducteurs avancés, des packages électroniques et des systèmes à l'échelle du wafer.

    Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie de nos clients afin de comprendre leurs problématiques techniques, de leur apporter une expertise approfondie et de démontrer clairement comment Vinci peut répondre à leurs cas d'usage concrets. Vous jouerez également un rôle essentiel d'interface entre les clients et nos équipes Product et Engineering, en transformant les retours du terrain en informations exploitables pour orienter la feuille de route produit et contribuer à l'amélioration continue de la plateforme.

    Ce poste est basé en France et exercé en télétravail, avec une collaboration étroite avec les équipes Sales, Product et Engineering basées à Palo Alto, en Californie. Il implique des déplacements réguliers mais modérés, principalement en Europe continentale, ainsi que des déplacements occasionnels aux États-Unis pour collaborer avec l'équipe américaine.

    Responsabilités

    • Construire, diriger et développer une équipe performante d'ingénieur/es en thermomécanique, en définissant l'orientation technique, en recrutant et accompagnant les membres de l'équipe, et en pilotant l'exécution sur le terrain à travers l'Europe.

    • Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe Sales pour diriger les discussions techniques, définir le périmètre des évaluations en proof-of-concept (PoC) et réaliser des démonstrations de produits convaincantes auprès de clients industriels potentiels.

    • Accompagner les équipes d'ingénierie des clients pendant la phase d'évaluation en supervisant la mise en place des simulations, l'exécution de cas de test complexes et l'interprétation des résultats afin de démontrer concrètement la valeur technique et business de Vinci.

    • Piloter l'accompagnement technique des clients, notamment l'onboarding, le déploiement et l'expansion des comptes, en fournissant une expertise technique de haut niveau, des sessions de formation structurées et un support avancé pour la résolution des problèmes.

    • Fournir des orientations et des retours sur le produit, identifier les difficultés rencontrées par les clients et les points de friction dans leurs workflows, et collaborer directement avec les équipes Produit et Engineering internes afin de transformer les retours du terrain en fonctionnalités produit clés.

    • Représenter Vinci lors de grandes conférences industrielles et d'événements dédiés aux semi-conducteurs, en échangeant avec des prospects et partenaires stratégiques à travers des présentations techniques et des démonstrations en direct de la plateforme.

    • Maintenir une excellente compréhension des technologies concurrentes, des tendances du secteur et du positionnement du marché afin de communiquer efficacement les éléments différenciants de Vinci.

    Qualifications (Qualifications minimales)

    Formation : Diplôme d'ingénieur ou équivalent (Master, doctorat) en génie mécanique, génie électrique ou dans un domaine technique étroitement lié.

    Expertise technique : Maîtrise approfondie de logiciels de simulation commerciaux (Ansys, Abaqus ou équivalent), avec plus de 15 ans d'expérience pratique en simulation thermomécanique — que ce soit en réalisant vous-même des simulations ou dans une fonction de Technical Account Manager pour des logiciels commerciaux de simulation physique.

    Domaine industriel : Solide connaissance des technologies de packaging électronique pour les semi-conducteurs, des technologies de packaging avancé (par exemple, IC 2.5D/3D) ou des écosystèmes de fonderies.

    Relation client : Expérience préalable dans des fonctions directement orientées client, avec une forte capacité à établir une relation de confiance et à gérer des relations avec des équipes d'ingénierie côté client.

    Automatisation & scripting : Expérience pratique en programmation avec Python ou C++ pour automatiser des flux de travail ou analyser des données issues de simulations.

    Leadership : Expérience avérée en management ou en leadership technique, avec la capacité à développer une équipe, accompagner ses membres et piloter l'exécution au sein d'équipes d'ingénierie.

    Communication : Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et de communication, avec une capacité démontrée à transformer des résultats complexes de physique et de simulation en messages clairs et à fort impact, aussi bien pour des publics techniques de haut niveau que pour des directions non spécialistes.

    Profil recherché (Atouts différenciants)

    Expertise multiphysique : Connaissance de la gestion thermique et des solutions de refroidissement et/ou des flux de travail Signal Integrity et Power Integrity (SI/PI).

    Expérience commerciale : Expérience directe dans la commercialisation de logiciels techniques — idéalement des outils d'Electronic Design Automation (EDA) ou de simulation CAE — auprès de grandes entreprises des secteurs des semi-conducteurs et de l'électronique.

    Parcours Go-to-Market : Passage préalable par des fonctions de pré-vente technique, d'ingénierie applicative (FAE) ou de vente technique stratégique.

    Technologies émergentes : Capacité à adopter rapidement et à promouvoir des flux de travail de nouvelle génération fondés sur la physique, ainsi que des outils de conception ou de simulation assistés par l'IA.

    Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

    • Ne vous contentez pas d'utiliser l'IA : rejoignez une équipe qui redéfinit activement la manière dont le silicium et les systèmes hardware de nouvelle génération sont conçus.

    • Travaillez à la convergence de modèles d'IA de pointe, de la physique fondamentale et de projets industriels à forts enjeux.

    • Collaborez avec des équipes d'ingénierie et de recherche de renommée mondiale, dans un environnement de start-up en forte croissance.

    Lieu : Paris ou Grenoble, France

    Type d'emploi : Temps plein

Alan exists to end the wait.

It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Business Segment Lead role ⭐️

At Alan, we split the French market in several business segments, each of them corresponding to a category of clients (whether by size, or industry).

The role of a Business Segment Lead is to reach market leadership in their given segment. To succeed, you will have to (1) articulate a vision for your segment, (2) define priorities and resources to deliver, and (3) make strategic decisions for your segment based on market insights.

The Business Segment Lead role is made for transversal influence as we operate based on distributed ownership. You will work closely with all teams involved in the success of your segment (Product, Insurance, Sales, Marketing). You will also collaborate with other segment leaders to build-up knowledge, share best practices, and create alignment around a long-term value plan.

Main missions include:

  • Market intelligence: You’ll build expertise on our market and competitive landscape. You’ll work both on the quantitative side (sizing) and the qualitative side (customers’ pain points and needs).

  • Value proposition and pricing: Our goal is to differentiate our offer from the market. You’ll relentlessly ask yourself: what is the best product offering to become leader in this segment?

  • Go-to-Market strategy: You’ll work both on renewal (account management) and expansion strategy (business development). This will require you to adapt and innovate when it comes to distribution channels, sub-segments, and partners management.

  • P&L ownership & Resources allocation: You’ll own the return on investment of your segment and are in charge of building the case for internal resources allocation based on your P&L.

  • Product trade-off: You’ll work together with product teams in order for us to build the best product based on market insights.

We are currently hiring for new segments:

  • It gathers several, high potential sub-segments where everything is to be built.

  • We will focus heavily on those new opportunities in the coming years.

⭐️ If you have some of the following, you may be a great fit ⭐️

  • At least 8 years of prior experience leading a business (product category, business segment, etc.)

  • Full working proficiency in French

  • At least advanced level in English

  • An exceptional ability to establish transversal influence

  • Used to analyze and manipulate data to build a 360 degree view of your market

  • A strong business sense while being able to go deep into product considerations

  • Able to articulate clear strategies in spite of complexity/uncertainty

  • A prior experience working with senior leadership

  • You are a generalist self-starter (Vs a specialist of 1 single industry) able to adapt fast and not afraid to go on the field to support your team mates and learn from them

  • You are based in (or willing to relocate to) either Paris, Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

For this role, we are looking to hire within the E-F level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - ****it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you. Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements? Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 800+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Mission

Alan is scaling internationally (800+ employees, 100+ healthcare professionals, 5+ countries) and needs IT Engineers to build and own the internal technology platform every Alaner works on: identity and provisioning, endpoint and SaaS security, the tooling behind our clinics, and the automation that keeps IT from scaling linearly with headcount.

The scope below is what the team owns, not a checklist for one person. You'll be staffed on one or two of these areas at a time, according to your strengths and interests, and it will evolve through time based on company needs and personal appetite.

Scope

⚙️ Platform & automation

  • Own and extend automations on Alan Home, our internal provisioning engine

  • Maintain, extend and improve helpdesk automation, SaaS provisioning flows, and onboarding/offboarding pipelines

  • Own the meeting room AV and room-booking platform as a product, replicable across offices

🔑 Identity & access

  • Own the IT side of the employee lifecycle (onboarding, offboarding, mobility between jobs and countries) across Google Workspace, SSO/SAML and our SaaS ecosystem.

  • Grow our role-based access model: extend it to more tools and refine the permission groups, so access is granted by role rather than case by case

  • Make employee lifecycle events reliable, fast and auditable end-to-end

  • Own access reviews and least-privilege models; produce and maintain the evidence our auditors rely on

  • Own SaaS procurement and license management: vendor relationships, renewals, and cost optimization across our stack

🔒 Endpoint & SaaS security

  • Own the Mac fleet in Kandji: enrollment at scale, role-based blueprints, fleet compliance

  • Cloudflare WARP, SaaS security controls

  • Maintain and strengthen our ISO 27001 certification and drive ACPR and pentest remediation on the endpoint and platform scope

🩺 Health Professionals IT

  • The IT layer behind Alan's clinics: practitioner tooling, equipment, access

  • Role and permission automation for healthcare professionals, and their support and escalation process

🌍 Internationalisation

  • Make international expansion something IT accelerates, not something it slows down: a repeatable process where every new market (Canada, KSA, Armenia...) launches on our standard stack from day one

  • Bring acquired entities onto that same platform

Milestones

First 3 months

  • Acquire technical knowledge on Alan's platform: Alan Home, Google Workspace/SSO, Kandji, Cloudflare WARP

  • Take one project end-to-end and ship a first increment

  • Join the IT oncall team as technical escalation

First 6 months

  • Own a workstream end-to-end, with an IT Ops teammate working alongside you

  • Deliver one automation or hardening initiative end-to-end

  • Take up documentation and automation on your scope and reduce significantly the bus factor on it

  • Mentor IT teammates on your core expertise

First year

  • Deliver measurable IT toil reduction on your scope

  • Set the technical standards on your domain: how we build, document and review it

  • Build strong cross-functional partnerships (Engineering, Security, Workplace, Clinic, People, Audit)

  • Contribute to hiring and onboarding new teammates

3 years

  • Lead major projects end-to-end across several communities

  • Be the reference the team relies on across at least two domains

  • Mentor the IT team and beyond, and scale IT without a linear increase in manual work

As the community grows, there is room to take on more responsibility: leading a crew, owning cross-community projects, mentoring, hiring.

Cette progression au sein du rôle de BDR te permettra de développer des compétences commerciales complètes qui te prépareront à une future mobilité interne en tant qu'Account Executive ou Inbound Sales.

La vision d'Alan est de faire de la prévention la nouvelle norme de soin pour tous.

Notre mission est d'aider les gens à vivre en bonne santé jusqu'à 100 ans tout en aidant les employeurs à être fiers, transformant les avantages santé d'un centre de coûts en leur investissement le plus précieux.

Responsabilité partagée — Chacun est responsable de ses décisions et de ses résultats.

En constante évolution — Du feedback direct, positif et bienveillant, associé à une prise en charge de son propre développement personnel.

Chaque Alaner est accompagné par un coach dédié dès le premier jour, qui aide à maximiser son impact, nourrir l'engagement, et naviguer les valeurs d'Alan pour développer son plein potentiel.
